sodexo.name: Sodexo
sodexo.description: Sodexo is a French food services and facilities management company headquartered in Issy-les-Moulineaux, a suburb of Paris. It operates in 43 countries, serving 80 million customers daily across 27,000 sites. Sodexo is the largest France-based private employer worldwide.

sf-express.name: SF Express
sf-express.description: SF Express is a Chinese multinational delivery services and logistics company based in Shenzhen, Guangdong. It is the largest courier in China and provides domestic and international express delivery. The company operates a fleet of cargo aircraft owned by its subsidiary SF Airlines.

starbucks.name: Starbucks
starbucks.description: Starbucks Corporation is an American multinational chain of coffeehouses and roastery reserves headquartered in Seattle, Washington. Founded in 1971, it started as a coffee bean wholesaler and later expanded into a coffee shop serving espresso-based drinks. It grew significantly under CEO Howard Schultz.

sinopec.name: Sinopec
sinopec.description: China Petroleum and Chemical Corporation, or Sinopec Group, is a Chinese oil and gas enterprise based in Chaoyang District, Beijing. It is a state-owned enterprise administered by the SASAC for the benefit of the State Council of China. Sinopec Group is the world's largest oil refining conglomerate and operates a publicly traded subsidiary listed in Hong Kong and Shanghai.

sberbank.name: Sberbank
sberbank.description: The Public JSC Sberbank is a Russian majority state-owned banking and financial services company headquartered in Moscow. It is the successor entity of the State Labor Savings Banks System of the USSR. The company shortened its brand to Sber in 2020.

saic-motor.name: SAIC Motor
saic-motor.description: SAIC Motor Corp., Ltd. is a Chinese state-owned automobile manufacturer headquartered in Anting, Shanghai. Founded in 1955, it is the largest of China's "Big Four" state-owned car manufacturers.

santander-group.name: Santander Group
santander-group.description: Banco Santander S.A., trading as Santander Group, is a Spanish multinational financial services company based in Santander. It is Europe's fourth largest bank by assets and operates across Europe, the Americas, and Asia.

sumitomo-electric-industries.name: Sumitomo Electric Industries
sumitomo-electric-industries.description: Sumitomo Electric Industries, Ltd. is a Japanese manufacturer of electric wire and optical fiber cables headquartered in Chūō-ku, Osaka. The company is publicly traded on the Tokyo, Nagoya, and Fukuoka Stock Exchanges. It reported consolidated sales of US$26.5 billion for the period ending March 2021.

saint-gobain.name: Saint-Gobain
saint-gobain.description: Compagnie de Saint-Gobain S.A. is a French multinational corporation founded in 1665 and headquartered near Paris. Originally a mirror manufacturer, it now produces a variety of construction and performance materials. Saint-Gobain operates in 76 countries and employs over 170,000 people as of 2022.

societe-generale.name: Société Générale
societe-generale.description: Société Générale S.A. is a French multinational universal bank and financial services company founded in 1864. It is registered in Paris and headquartered in La Défense. The company operates in the financial services sector globally.

scotiabank.name: Scotiabank
scotiabank.description: Scotiabank, officially The Bank of Nova Scotia, is a Canadian multinational banking and financial services company headquartered in Toronto, Ontario. It is one of Canada's Big Five banks and offers personal, commercial, wealth management, corporate, and investment services globally.

standard-chartered.name: Standard Chartered
standard-chartered.description: Standard Chartered PLC is a British multinational bank that operates in wealth management, corporate and investment banking, and treasury services. It is headquartered in the United Kingdom.

seiko-epson.name: Seiko Epson
seiko-epson.description: Seiko Epson Corporation, commonly known as Epson, is a Japanese multinational headquartered in Suwa, Nagano. It is one of the world's largest manufacturers of printers and imaging-related equipment, producing a wide range of electronic components and devices.

strabag.name: Strabag
strabag.description: Strabag is an Austrian international technology group for the built environment headquartered in Vienna. It is the largest construction company in Austria and operates in various European countries, the Arabian Peninsula, Australia, Canada, Chile, China, India, and Africa. The company has subsidiaries or operates on a project basis in these markets.

sistema.name: Sistema
sistema.description: AFK Sistema PAO is a large Russian conglomerate founded by Vladimir Yevtushenkov. In April 2022, Yevtushenkov's shareholding decreased to 49.2% and he stepped down from the board of directors. The company is based in Russia and operates as a diversified conglomerate.

sabmiller.name: SABMiller
sabmiller.description: SABMiller plc was an Anglo–South African multinational brewing and beverage company headquartered in Woking, England. It was the world's second-largest brewer by revenue and a major Coca-Cola bottler. The company operated in 80 countries and was acquired by AB InBev in 2016.

suzuki-motor-corporation.name: Suzuki Motor Corporation
suzuki-motor-corporation.description: Suzuki Motor Corporation is a Japanese multinational mobility manufacturer headquartered in Hamamatsu, Shizuoka. It produces automobiles, motorcycles, ATVs, outboard marine engines, wheelchairs, and various small internal combustion engines.

sysco.name: Sysco
sysco.description: Sysco is an American multinational corporation headquartered in Houston, Texas. It sells, markets, and distributes food products and foodservice supplies to restaurants, healthcare and educational facilities, sports stadiums, and other venues.

sprint-corporation.name: Sprint Corporation
sprint-corporation.description: Sprint Corporation was an American telecommunications company and the fourth-largest mobile network operator in the US before its acquisition by T-Mobile US in 2020. It provided wireless voice, messaging, and broadband services through subsidiaries like Boost Mobile and Open Mobile.

seagate-technology.name: Seagate Technology
seagate-technology.description: Seagate Technology Holdings plc is an American multinational data storage company incorporated in Dublin, Ireland since 2010. It was originally incorporated as Shugart Technology in 1978 and began business in 1979. Its operational headquarters are in Fremont, California, United States.

skanska.name: Skanska
skanska.description: Skanska AB is a multinational construction and development company based in Sweden. It was established in 1887 originally as a concrete product manufacturer. The company operates in the construction industry.

seven-i-holdings-co.name: Seven & I Holdings Co.
seven-i-holdings-co.description: Seven & I Holdings Co., Ltd. is a Japanese diversified retail holdings company headquartered in Tokyo. It was established in 2005 by integrating Ito-Yokado, Seven-Eleven Japan, and Denny's Japan to create a holding company for these entities. The formation was driven by the contrasting performance of its parent and subsidiary companies.

sharp-corporation.name: Sharp Corporation
sharp-corporation.description: Sharp Corporation is a Japanese electronics company headquartered in Sakai, Osaka. Founded in 1912, it was established as Hayakawa Metal Works Institute in 1924. Since 2016, it has been majority owned by Taiwan-based Foxconn.

sopra-steria.name: Sopra Steria
sopra-steria.description: Sopra Steria is a European consulting, digital services, and software development company headquartered in Paris. It employs 50,000 consultants and operates in several Western European countries.

severstal.name: Severstal
severstal.description: Severstal is a Russian company operating mainly in the steel and mining industry, headquartered in Cherepovets. It is the largest steel company in Russia and is listed on the Moscow Exchange and LSE. The company is majority-owned by Alexey Mordashov.

smurfit-westrock-group.name: Smurfit Westrock Group
smurfit-westrock-group.description: Smurfit Westrock plc is an Irish company based in Dublin that manufactures corrugated and paper-based packaging. It is publicly traded on both the New York Stock Exchange and the London Stock Exchange.

sun-microsystems.name: Sun Microsystems
sun-microsystems.description: Sun Microsystems, Inc. was an American technology company from 1982 to 2010 that developed and sold computers, hardware, software, and IT services. It contributed to key computing technologies and was headquartered in Santa Clara, California.

s-p-global.name: S&P Global
s-p-global.description: S&P Global Inc. is an American publicly traded corporation headquartered in Manhattan, New York. It provides financial information, analytics, and energy and commodities intelligence, and owns several subsidiaries including S&P Global Ratings and CRISIL.

state-street-corporation.name: State Street Corporation
state-street-corporation.description: State Street Corporation is an American multinational financial services and bank holding company headquartered in Boston. It is the second-oldest continuously operating U.S. bank, tracing its roots to 1792. State Street is one of the world's largest asset managers and custodians.

sumitomo-chemical.name: Sumitomo Chemical
sumitomo-chemical.description: Sumitomo Chemical Co., Ltd. is a major Japanese chemical company founded in 1913 as a fertilizer manufacturer. It is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and is part of the Sumitomo group. The company operates in the industrial and chemical sectors.

shiseido.name: Shiseido
shiseido.description: Shiseido Company, Limited is a Japanese multinational cosmetic company founded in Tokyo in 1872. It offers products in skin care, makeup, body care, hair care, and fragrances. Shiseido is the largest cosmetic firm in Japan and is headquartered in Tokyo.

sabadell-bank.name: Sabadell Bank
sabadell-bank.description: Banco de Sabadell, S.A. is a Spanish multinational financial services company headquartered in Sabadell, Catalonia. It is the fourth-largest banking group in Spain and serves small and medium enterprises as well as affluent clients, with a focus on international trade.

smiths-group.name: Smiths Group
smiths-group.description: Smiths Group plc is a British multinational diversified engineering business headquartered in London, England. It operates in over 50 countries and employs approximately 16,000 staff. Smiths Group is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index.

solventum.name: Solventum
solventum.description: Solventum Corporation is an American health care company that was spun off from 3M on April 1, 2024. It operates in the health care sector.

spacex.name: SpaceX
spacex.description: Space Exploration Technologies Corp., known as SpaceX, is an American aerospace manufacturer and provider of space transportation, telecommunications, infrastructure, and AI services. Headquartered in Starbase, Texas, it operates segments including space launch vehicles, satellite internet via Starlink, and AI development through its subsidiary.

saab-group.name: Saab Group
saab-group.description: Saab AB, known as the Saab Group, is a Swedish aerospace and defence company headquartered in Stockholm. It primarily operates in Sweden with development and manufacturing based in Linköping. The company is notable for its focus on aerospace and defence sectors.

stantec.name: Stantec
stantec.description: Stantec Inc. is a multinational professional services company founded in 1954 and based in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada. It provides consulting services in planning, engineering, architecture, and environmental sciences worldwide. The company operates from over 450 locations across six continents.

stryker-corporation.name: Stryker Corporation
stryker-corporation.description: Stryker Corporation is an American multinational medical technologies company headquartered in Portage, Michigan. It produces surgical equipment, neurotechnology products, and orthopedic implants used in various surgeries. Its products are sold in over 75 countries and used by 150 million patients annually.

swisscom.name: Swisscom
swisscom.description: Swisscom AG is a major telecommunications provider in Switzerland with headquarters in Worblaufen, near Bern. The Swiss government owns 51% of Swisscom. It holds significant market shares in mobile, broadband, and TV telecommunications in Switzerland and operates the Italian subsidiary Fastweb.

sk-telecom.name: SK Telecom
sk-telecom.description: SK Telecom Co., Ltd. is a South Korean wireless telecommunications operator and part of the SK Group. It is the largest wireless carrier in South Korea, leading the local market with a significant share. SK Telecom was formerly also a film distributor.

saudi-telecom-company.name: Saudi Telecom Company
saudi-telecom-company.description: Saudi Telecom Company, trading as stc Group, is a telecommunications provider based in Saudi Arabia. It offers ICT services across the Middle East and Europe, including landline, mobile, broadband, cloud computing, online payments, IoT, 5G, cybersecurity, and digital entertainment.

sudzucker.name: Südzucker
sudzucker.description: Südzucker AG is a German company and the largest sugar producer in the world, with an annual production of around 4.8 million tonnes.

suzano-papel-e-celulose.name: Suzano Papel e Celulose
suzano-papel-e-celulose.description: Suzano Papel e Celulose is a Brazilian paper and pulp producer with operations in over 80 countries. It is the largest paper and pulp company in Latin America and has offices in cities including Salvador, São Paulo, Buenos Aires, and London.

sanoma-corporation.name: Sanoma Corporation
sanoma-corporation.description: Sanoma Corporation is Finland's largest media group and a European education publisher headquartered in Helsinki. It operates media businesses in Finland and education businesses in twelve European countries.

synchrony-financial.name: Synchrony Financial
synchrony-financial.description: Synchrony Financial is an American consumer financial services company headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut. It offers consumer financing products such as credit, promotional financing, loyalty programs, and installment lending through its wholly owned online bank subsidiary, Synchrony Bank.

sun-life-financial.name: Sun Life Financial
sun-life-financial.description: Sun Life Financial Inc. is a financial services company headquartered in Toronto, Canada. Founded in 1865, it operates internationally in life insurance, wealth management, and asset management.

stadler-rail.name: Stadler Rail
stadler-rail.description: Stadler Rail AG is a Swiss manufacturer of railway rolling stock based in Bussnang, Switzerland. The company produces regional multiple unit trains, trams, rapid transit, high-speed rail, intercity, sleeper train vehicles, and rack railway rolling stock.

syensqo.name: SYENSQO
syensqo.description: Syensqo is a Belgian multinational chemicals and advanced materials company headquartered in Brussels. It was established in December 2023 through a spin-off from Solvay and is led by CEO Mike Radossich since January 2026.

suzlon-energy.name: Suzlon Energy
suzlon-energy.description: Suzlon Energy is an Indian multinational wind turbine manufacturer headquartered in Pune, Western India. The company operates in the renewable energy industry, focusing on wind energy solutions.

solidcore-resources.name: Solidcore Resources
solidcore-resources.description: Solidcore Resources plc, formerly Polymetal International plc until June 2024, is a mining company registered in Kazakhstan. It operates two mines and one major development project in Kazakhstan. The company focuses on exploration and processing refractory ores.

smith-nephew.name: Smith & Nephew
smith-nephew.description: Smith & Nephew plc is a British multinational medical equipment manufacturer headquartered in Watford, England. It produces advanced wound management, arthroscopy, trauma, clinical therapy, and orthopaedic reconstruction products sold in over 100 countries.

servicenow.name: ServiceNow
servicenow.description: ServiceNow, Inc. is an American software company founded in 2003 in Santa Clara, California. It provides cloud computing platforms for creating and managing automated business workflows and is listed on the New York Stock Exchange.

scandic-hotels-group.name: Scandic Hotels Group
scandic-hotels-group.description: Scandic Hotels is a Swedish hotel chain headquartered in Stockholm with operations mainly in the Nordic countries and presence in Germany and Poland. It operates hundreds of hotels and tens of thousands of guest rooms.

skechers.name: Skechers
skechers.description: Skechers U.S.A., Inc. is an American multinational footwear and apparel manufacturing company founded in 1992. It is headquartered in Manhattan Beach, California, and is the third largest footwear brand in the world.

svb-financial-group.name: SVB Financial Group
svb-financial-group.description: SVB Financial Group is a financial services holding company headquartered in New York City. Its main business unit was Silicon Valley Bank until the bank failed in March 2023. As of December 31, 2022, it had 164 subsidiaries.

stifel.name: Stifel
stifel.description: Stifel Financial Corp. is an American multinational independent investment bank and financial services company headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri. It was created under the Stifel name in 1983, with a predecessor founded in 1890.

sunpower.name: SunPower
sunpower.description: SunPower Corporation is an American provider of photovoltaic solar energy systems and battery storage products, mainly for residential customers. Founded in 1985 and headquartered in San Jose, California, it has had significant ownership changes including investments by Cypress Semiconductor and TotalEnergies.

s-p-korolev-rocket-and-space-corporation.name: S.P. Korolev Rocket and Space Corporation Energia
s-p-korolev-rocket-and-space-corporation.legal_name: S.P. Korolev Rocket and Space Corporation Energia
s-p-korolev-rocket-and-space-corporation.description: S.P. Korolev Rocket and Space Corporation Energia, known as RSC Energia, is a Russian aerospace manufacturer and spacecraft design bureau headquartered in Korolyov, Moscow Oblast. It is the principal contractor for Russia's human spaceflight program, producing crewed and cargo spacecraft, space station modules, and satellite platforms.

listings.name: S.P. Korolev Rocket and Space Corporation Energia

steel-dynamics.name: Steel Dynamics
steel-dynamics.description: Steel Dynamics, Inc. is an American steel producer based in Fort Wayne, Indiana. It is the third largest producer of carbon steel products in the United States and is among the most profitable American steel companies by profit margins and operating margin per ton.

sunedison.name: SunEdison
sunedison.description: SunEdison, Inc. was a U.S.-based renewable energy company involved in developing, building, owning, and operating solar and wind energy plants. It also manufactured high-purity polysilicon, silicon wafers, solar modules, and related systems. The company originated as Monsanto Electronic Materials Company in 1959 and was sold by Monsanto in 1989.

shizuoka-bank.name: Shizuoka Bank
shizuoka-bank.description: The Shizuoka Bank Ltd. is a Japanese regional bank headquartered in Shizuoka, Shizuoka Prefecture. It is one of the largest regional banks in Japan with over 190 domestic branches and overseas offices in several major cities.

showa-shell-sekiyu.name: Showa Shell Sekiyu
showa-shell-sekiyu.description: Showa Shell Sekiyu K.K. was a Japanese petroleum company formed by the merger of Showa Oil Company and Shell Sekiyu. It was a subsidiary of Royal Dutch Shell until acquired by Idemitsu Kosan in 2018.

sandoz.name: Sandoz
sandoz.description: Sandoz Group AG is a Swiss company specializing in generic pharmaceuticals and biosimilars. Formerly part of Novartis, it became independent in October 2023 with headquarters in Basel, Switzerland, and global functions in Germany, Czechia, and Spain.

sirius-xm-rad.name: Sirius XM Rad
sirius-xm-rad.description: Sirius XM Holdings Inc. is an American broadcasting corporation headquartered in Midtown Manhattan, New York City. It provides satellite and online radio services in the US and holds a 70% equity interest in SiriusXM Canada. The company was formed by merging Sirius Satellite Radio and XM Satellite Radio in 2008.

shire-plc.name: Shire plc
shire-plc.description: Shire plc was a specialty biopharmaceutical company originally founded in the United Kingdom and registered in Jersey. It had an operational base in the United States and produced brands including Vyvanse, Lialda, and Adderall XR. Shire was acquired by Takeda Pharmaceutical Company in January 2019.

square-enix.name: Square Enix
square-enix.description: Square Enix Holdings Co., Ltd. is a Japanese multinational holding company involved in video game development, publishing, and entertainment. It is known for role-playing game franchises like Final Fantasy, Kingdom Hearts, and Dragon Quest, and also operates in merchandise, arcade facilities, and manga publication.

skyworks-solutions.name: Skyworks Solutions
skyworks-solutions.description: Skyworks Solutions, Inc. is an American semiconductor company headquartered in Irvine, California. It is listed on the Nasdaq Global Select Market and is a constituent of the S&P 500. The company operates in the semiconductor industry.

saizeriya.name: Saizeriya
saizeriya.description: Saizeriya is a Japanese chain of family-style Italian yōshoku restaurants managed by Saizeriya Co. Its headquarters are in Yoshikawa, Saitama, and it operates locations in Japan and several Asian countries, with a factory in Australia.

syriatel.name: Syriatel
syriatel.description: Syriatel is a mobile network provider in Syria headquartered on Sehnaya Road in Damascus. It offers LTE services under the brand name Super Surf and is one of two mobile network providers in the country.

schroders.name: Schroders
schroders.description: Schroders Limited is a British multinational asset management company headquartered in London, England. Founded in 1804, it employs over 6,000 people worldwide and was traded on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition by Nuveen in 2026. It ranks as the 21st largest asset management firm globally.

sumitomo-heavy-industries.name: Sumitomo Heavy Industries
sumitomo-heavy-industries.description: Sumitomo Heavy Industries, Ltd. is a Japanese integrated manufacturer producing industrial machinery, defense products, ships, bridges, steel structures, environmental protection equipment, power transmission equipment, plastic molding machines, laser processing systems, particle accelerators, material handling systems, and cancer diagnostic and treatment equipment.

sthree.name: SThree
sthree.description: SThree plc is an international specialist staffing organization founded and headquartered in London, United Kingdom. It operates in the employment services industry and is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

southstate-bank.name: SouthState Bank
southstate-bank.description: SouthState Bank is an American bank based in Winter Haven, Florida, and a subsidiary of SouthState Corporation. It operates 371 branches across several states including South Carolina, North Carolina, Georgia, Florida, Alabama, Virginia, Colorado, and Texas.

storebrand.name: Storebrand
storebrand.description: Storebrand is a Norwegian financial services company primarily involved in life insurance and pension savings. It also operates divisions in investments, banking, and property and casualty insurance, and expanded into the Swedish life insurance market through acquiring SPP in 2007.

strategy.name: Strategy
strategy.description: Strategy Inc., formerly known as MicroStrategy, is an American company that provides business intelligence and mobile software. Founded in 1989, it is headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia. The company develops software to analyze data for business decisions and mobile app development.

simpson-manufacturing-company.name: Simpson Manufacturing Company
simpson-manufacturing-company.description: Simpson Manufacturing Company is a U.S.-based manufacturer of building materials. It produces structural connectors, fasteners, anchors, and products for new construction and retrofitting.

saco-hardware.name: SACO Hardware
saco-hardware.description: SACO is a Saudi Arabian company providing home improvement products. Founded in 1984 with one store in Riyadh, it has expanded to operate 34 stores across 18 cities. The stores vary in size, with some occupying up to 24,500 square meters.

santos.name: Santos
santos.description: Santos Limited is an Australian oil and gas exploration and production company headquartered in Adelaide. It owns LNG, pipeline gas, and oil assets and is the largest natural gas supplier in Australia, operating in the Cooper Basin and offshore regions.

stelco.name: Stelco
stelco.description: Stelco Holdings Inc. is a steel company based in Hamilton, Ontario, Canada. Founded in 1910, it has undergone ownership changes including acquisition by U.S. Steel and later by Bedrock Industries. In 2024, it was acquired by American steel manufacturer Cleveland-Cliffs.

samsung-card.name: Samsung Card
samsung-card.description: Samsung Card Co, Ltd. is a South Korean credit card company established in 1988 and headquartered in Seoul. It merged with Samsung Capital in 2004 and is owned by Samsung Life Insurance. The company serves millions of individual credit card users in South Korea.

silvano-fashion-group.name: Silvano Fashion Group
silvano-fashion-group.description: Silvano Fashion Group is an Estonian company specializing in designing, manufacturing, and selling ladies' lingerie. It operates within the clothing industry and is based in Estonia.

scripps-networks-interactive.name: Scripps Networks Interactive
scripps-networks-interactive.description: Scripps Networks Interactive, Inc. was an American mass media company formed in 2008 and acquired by Discovery Communications in 2018. It owned several major factual television cable channels including Food Network, HGTV, and Travel Channel. The company was based in the United States.

stock-spirits-group.name: Stock Spirits Group
stock-spirits-group.description: Stock Spirits Group is a European alcohol beverage company with origins dating back to 1884 in Trieste. Since November 2022, it has been owned by private equity firm CVC Capital Partners. The company is among the largest in its industry in Europe.

shepherd-neame-limited.name: Shepherd Neame Limited
shepherd-neame-limited.description: Shepherd Neame is an independent English brewery based in Faversham, Kent, with a history dating back to 1698. It produces a range of cask ales and filtered beers and operates 286 pubs and hotels mainly in South East England. The company exports its products to 44 countries.

spar-nord-bank.name: Spar Nord Bank
spar-nord-bank.description: Spar Nord Bank A/S is a bank based in North Jutland, Denmark.

samsung-biologics.name: Samsung Biologics
samsung-biologics.description: Samsung Biologics Co., Ltd. is a global contract development and manufacturing organization headquartered in Songdo, Incheon, South Korea. It is the biotech division of Samsung Group, focusing on monoclonal antibodies, bispecific antibodies, antibody-drug conjugates, and mRNA vaccines.

snowflake-inc.name: Snowflake Inc.
snowflake-inc.description: Snowflake Inc. is an American cloud-based artificial intelligence data platform company founded in San Mateo, California, and headquartered in Menlo Park. It operates a platform supporting data analysis with minimal latency on major cloud providers like AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.

sparebanken-norge.name: Sparebanken Norge
sparebanken-norge.description: Sparebanken Norge is a Norwegian banking and financial services group formed in 2025 by merging Sparebanken Vest and Sparebanken Sør. It is headquartered jointly in Bergen and Kristiansand and is the largest savings bank in Norway by assets and branch count as of 2025.

sturm-ruger-co.name: Sturm, Ruger & Co.
sturm-ruger-co.description: Sturm, Ruger & Company, Inc., known as Ruger, is an American firearm manufacturer based in Mayodan, North Carolina, with production facilities in several states. Founded in 1949, it has been publicly traded since 1969.

smart-technologies.name: SMART Technologies
smart-technologies.description: Smart Technologies is a Canadian company headquartered in Calgary, Alberta, and wholly owned by Foxconn. Founded in 1987, it is known for developing interactive whiteboards branded as Smart Board, widely used in education and business.

similarweb.name: Similarweb
similarweb.description: Similarweb Ltd. is a global software and data aggregation company specializing in mobile app and web analytics, digital performance, and SEO tools. Founded in Israel, it has 12 offices worldwide and went public on the New York Stock Exchange in 2021.

sparebank-1-nord-norge.name: SpareBank 1 Nord-Norge
sparebank-1-nord-norge.description: SpareBank 1 Nord-Norge is a Norwegian savings bank with 90 branches across northern Norway and a head office in Tromsø. It serves private and institutional customers and is a founding member of the SpareBank 1 alliance.

sparebanken-vest.name: Sparebanken Vest
sparebanken-vest.description: Sparebanken Vest was a savings bank based in Bergen, Norway, serving Western Norway. It was the third-largest savings bank in Norway with branches throughout Møre og Romsdal, Vestland, and Rogaland regions.

sm-entertainment.name: SM Entertainment
sm-entertainment.description: SM Entertainment Co., Ltd. is a South Korean multinational entertainment agency established in 1995 by Lee Soo-man. It operates as a record label, talent agency, music production company, event management, concert production, and music publishing house. The company is known for leading the worldwide K-pop phenomenon.

stratasys.name: Stratasys
stratasys.description: Stratasys, Ltd. is an American-Israeli manufacturer of 3D printers, software, and materials for polymer additive manufacturing. The company is incorporated in Israel and produces systems used to model complex geometries in various polymer materials. It serves the 3D printing industry.

sectra-ab.name: Sectra AB
sectra-ab.description: Sectra AB is a Swedish company founded in 1978 that operates in medical technology and encrypted communication systems. It produces the RAKEL communication system used by Swedish emergency services and public utility providers. The company is based in Sweden.

songa-offshore-se.name: Songa Offshore SE
songa-offshore-se.description: Songa Offshore SE is a European offshore drilling contractor founded in 2005. It has offices in Cyprus, Stavanger, Oslo, Houston, Kuala Lumpur, Aberdeen, and Singapore.

sentul-city.name: Sentul City
sentul-city.description: Sentul City is a modern housing area located in Sentul, Babakan Madang, Bogor Regency, West Java, Indonesia. It is situated near Bogor and about 48 km south of Jakarta, Indonesia's capital. The township covers approximately 3100 hectares at the western foot of the Jonggol Mountains.

saf-tehnika.name: SAF Tehnika
saf-tehnika.industry: Business and other management consultancy activities
saf-tehnika.description: SAF Tehnika is a Latvian company that designs, manufactures, and distributes digital microwave data transmission equipment. Its products include digital microwave radio equipment, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and wireless sensor network solutions for environmental monitoring.

sparebank-1-stfold-akershus.name: SpareBank 1 Østfold Akershus
sparebank-1-stfold-akershus.description: SpareBank 1 Østfold Akershus is a Norwegian savings bank headquartered in Moss. Its main market covers the Østfold and Akershus regions. The bank's history dates back to 1835.

synspective.name: Synspective
synspective.description: Synspective is a publicly traded space company formed in 2018 and based in Tokyo, Japan. The company specializes in synthetic aperture radar satellites and operates a constellation of these satellites for advanced earth imaging.

sparebank-1-nordmre.name: SpareBank 1 Nordmøre
sparebank-1-nordmre.description: SpareBank 1 Nordmøre is a Norwegian savings bank with branches in Nordmøre, Molde, and Ålesund. It has 11 branch offices and a head office in Kristiansund. The bank is part of the SpareBank 1 and Samarbeidende Sparebanker alliances.

skue-sparebank.name: Skue Sparebank
skue-sparebank.description: Skue Sparebank is a Norwegian savings bank headquartered in Nesbyen, Norway. Its main market is Buskerud, and its history dates back to 1842 with the establishment of Nes Prestegjelds Sparebank.

scatec-solar.name: Scatec Solar
scatec-solar.description: Scatec ASA, formerly Scatec Solar ASA, is a Norwegian renewable energy company founded in 2007. It was renamed in 2020 to reflect a broadened strategy beyond solar energy. Major shareholders include Scatec Innovation AS and Equinor.

sofina.name: Sofina
sofina.description: Sofina is a Belgian holding company headquartered in Brussels with offices in Singapore and Luxembourg. It is part of the Bel20 index and invests in multiple industrial sectors including telecommunications, banks, insurance, private equity, consumer goods, and energy. Its investments span several countries including Belgium, France, and China.

selvaag-bolig.name: Selvaag Bolig
selvaag-bolig.description: Selvaag Bolig ASA is a residential property developer headquartered in Oslo, Norway. It was established in 2008 when Selvaag Group's property development activities were separated into a new company.

sogn-sparebank.name: Sogn Sparebank
sogn-sparebank.description: Indre Sogn Sparebank is a Norwegian savings bank headquartered in Årdalstangen, Norway. Its main market is the area surrounding Sognefjorden.

sg-micro.name: SG Micro
sg-micro.description: SG Micro is a publicly listed semiconductor company based in Beijing, China. It specializes in analog chips as its main business focus.

sitronics.name: Sitronics
sitronics.description: Sitronics is a Russian microelectronics company owned by Sistema Holdings and based in Moscow. It operates electronics fabrication facilities and has R&D centers in Zelenograd and other parts of Eastern Europe.

savills.name: Savills
savills.description: Savills plc is a British multinational real estate services company headquartered in London. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index. The company provides a range of real estate services internationally.

sentinelone.name: SentinelOne
sentinelone.description: SentinelOne, Inc. is an American cybersecurity company based in Mountain View, California. Founded in 2013, it uses machine learning and patented behavioral AI to monitor personal computers, IoT devices, and cloud workloads. The company is AV-TEST certified.

subaru-corporation.name: Subaru Corporation
subaru-corporation.description: Subaru Corporation, formerly Fuji Heavy Industries, is a Japanese multinational conglomerate involved in terrestrial and aerospace transportation manufacturing. It is best known for Subaru automobiles and manufactures helicopters and airplanes under license for Boeing and Lockheed Martin.

shake-shack.name: Shake Shack
shake-shack.description: Shake Shack is an American multinational fast casual restaurant chain based in New York City. It began as a hot dog cart in Madison Square Park in 2001 and expanded to a permanent kiosk in 2004, broadening its menu to include hamburgers, hot dogs, fries, and milkshakes.

sangfor-technologies-inc.name: Sangfor Technologies Inc.
sangfor-technologies-inc.description: Sangfor Technologies is a Chinese technology company specializing in cybersecurity, cloud computing, and enterprise IT infrastructure. It serves enterprise customers and is publicly listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange. The company was founded by He Zhaoxi and Xiong Wu.

storytel.name: Storytel
storytel.description: Storytel AB is a Swedish e-book and audiobook subscription service based in Stockholm. It operates in more than 25 countries and its English audiobook service, Audiobooks.com, is available in over 150 countries.

serko.name: Serko
serko.description: Serko Limited is a travel management and expense technology company headquartered in New Zealand. It operates in the hotels and tourism sector.

singer.name: Singer
singer.description: Singer PLC is a Sri Lankan holding company engaged in retailing and wholesale marketing of home appliances and furniture. It also participates in financial services and manufacturing, and is listed on the Colombo Stock Exchange.

shenzhen-kangtai-biological-products.name: Shenzhen Kangtai Biological Products
shenzhen-kangtai-biological-products.description: Shenzhen Kangtai Biological Products, also known as BioKangtai, is a Chinese biopharmaceutical company that develops, manufactures, and markets vaccines and other vaccine products. It operates in the healthcare and pharmaceutical sector.

sumitomo-pharma.name: Sumitomo Pharma
sumitomo-pharma.description: Sumitomo Pharma Company Limited is a Japanese multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Osaka. It focuses on areas including oncology, psychiatry, neurology, women's health, and urological diseases.

softstar-entertainment.name: Softstar Entertainment
softstar-entertainment.description: Softstar Entertainment Inc. is a Taiwanese video game developer and publisher based in Zhonghe District, New Taipei. It has subsidiary branches in Beijing, Shanghai, and Xiamen. The company is known for its involvement in the video game industry.

silicon-motion.name: Silicon Motion
silicon-motion.description: Silicon Motion Technology Corporation is an American-Taiwanese company that develops NAND flash controller integrated circuits for solid-state storage devices. Its controllers are used in commercial, enterprise, and industrial applications including SSDs, eMMCs, memory cards, and USB flash drives. The company claims to have supplied more NAND flash controllers than any other company from 2006 to 2016.

sbi-holdings.name: SBI Holdings
sbi-holdings.description: SBI Holdings, Inc. is a financial services holdings corporation based in Tokyo, Japan. It is the primary holding company of the SBI Group, one of Japan's largest financial services conglomerates with over 635 subsidiaries.

scsk-corporation.name: SCSK Corporation
scsk-corporation.description: SCSK Corporation is a Japanese information technology company headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. It offers IT services and computer software.

sunshine-holdings-plc.name: Sunshine Holdings PLC
sunshine-holdings-plc.description: Sunshine Holdings PLC is a Sri Lankan conglomerate holding company engaged in healthcare, consumer goods, and agribusiness sectors. It was incorporated in 1973 and listed on the Colombo Stock Exchange in 1983. The company ranked 45th in the LMD 100 list of Sri Lankan quoted companies by revenue in 2020/21.

s-b-foods.name: S&B Foods
s-b-foods.description: S&B Foods Inc. is a Japanese company that manufactures, processes, and distributes foodstuffs, spices, condiments, and instant curries. It also makes and sells cooked food. The company's logo represents the words "Spice" and "Herb."

sparklight.name: Sparklight
sparklight.description: Cable One, Inc., operating under the Sparklight brand, is an American broadband communications provider headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona. It offers cable television, internet, and phone services across 24 U.S. states to 1.1 million customers and owns the Fidelity Communications brand serving five states.

service-corporation-international.name: Service Corporation International
service-corporation-international.description: Service Corporation International is an American provider of funeral goods and services, cemetery property, and cremation services. Headquartered in Neartown, Houston, Texas, it operates over 1500 funeral homes and 400 cemeteries, with secondary offices in Jefferson, Louisiana.

sailor-pen.name: Sailor Pen
sailor-pen.description: The Sailor Pen Company is a Japanese pen manufacturer based in Kure, Hiroshima. It is known for producing the first fountain pen in Japan with a gold nib and the first Japanese ballpoint pens.

sansei-technologies.name: Sansei Technologies
sansei-technologies.description: Sansei Technologies, Inc. is a Japanese manufacturing firm based in Osaka. The company specializes in manufacturing amusement rides, stage equipment, and elevators. It operates within the industrial manufacturing sector in Japan.

sanrio.name: Sanrio
sanrio.description: Sanrio Company, Ltd. is a Japanese entertainment company that designs, licenses, and manufactures products focused on the kawaii segment of Japanese popular culture. It sells stationery, school supplies, gifts, and accessories worldwide, including specialty brand retail stores in Japan. Sanrio's best-known character is Hello Kitty, a globally successful marketing brand.

swire-group.name: Swire Group
swire-group.description: Swire Group is a global conglomerate with its parent company John Swire & Sons Limited holding controlling stakes in businesses across the UK, USA, Australia, Papua New Guinea, East and West Africa, and Southeast Asia. Its businesses include property, aviation, beverages and food chain, marine services, and trading and industrial sectors.

screen-holdings.name: SCREEN Holdings
screen-holdings.description: SCREEN Holdings Co., Ltd. is a Japanese semiconductor and electronics company headquartered in Kyoto. It manufactures and sells equipment used in the production of semiconductors, flat panel displays, storage media, and precision technology manufacturing equipment.

shobunsha.name: Shobunsha
shobunsha.description: Shobunsha is a Japanese map publisher headquartered in Kōjimachi, Chiyoda, Tokyo. The company is known for its road maps and travel guidebook series.

shandong-airlines.name: Shandong Airlines
shandong-airlines.description: Shandong Airlines Co., Ltd. is a Chinese airline based in Jinan, Shandong. It operates domestic and regional international flights and is majorly owned by Shandong Aviation Group and Air China.

seibu-holdings.name: Seibu Holdings
seibu-holdings.description: Seibu Holdings Inc. is a Japanese multinational holding company owning Seibu Railway, Prince Hotels, Seibu Bus, and their subsidiaries, collectively known as the Seibu Group. It was formed in 2006 to restructure the group after a share ownership falsification scandal. The group includes fifty-three affiliated companies worldwide.

saibu-gas.name: Saibu Gas
saibu-gas.description: Saibu Gas Co., Ltd. is a Japanese gas company based in Fukuoka that supplies gas to the Northern Kyushu region, including Fukuoka, Saga, Nagasaki, and Kumamoto. It operates in the utilities sector and serves multiple areas in Japan.

sm-pictures.name: SM Pictures
sm-pictures.description: SM Pictures was a South Korean DVD distribution and film import company under SM Entertainment. Founded in 1999 as Bitwin, it was later acquired and renamed by SM Entertainment but closed after losses, with remaining stakes transferred in 2008.

spirit-airlines.name: Spirit Airlines
spirit-airlines.description: Spirit Airlines was an American ultra-low-cost airline based in Dania Beach, Florida. It operated flights across the United States, the Caribbean, and Latin America before ceasing all scheduled operations in 2026.

spansion.name: Spansion
spansion.description: Spansion Inc. was an American company headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, that designed and manufactured flash memory, microcontrollers, and system-on-chip solutions. It originated as a joint venture between AMD and Fujitsu before becoming independent.

samsonite.name: Samsonite
samsonite.description: Samsonite International S.A. is a Luxembourg-based multinational luggage manufacturer and retailer. Founded in 1910 in Denver, Colorado, it offers products ranging from large suitcases to small bags and briefcases.

saudi-investment-bank.name: Saudi Investment Bank
saudi-investment-bank.description: The Saudi Investment Bank is a Saudi joint stock bank established by Royal Decree in 1977. It operates within Saudi Arabia's banking sector.

saudi-electricity-company.name: Saudi Electricity Company
saudi-electricity-company.description: Saudi Energy, formerly Saudi Electricity Company, is the primary electric utility in Saudi Arabia. It operates across power generation, transmission, and distribution within the Kingdom.

shochiku.name: Shochiku
shochiku.description: Shochiku Co., Ltd. is a Japanese entertainment company founded in 1895. It manages kabuki theaters and is one of Japan's Big Four film studios, known for its long history in film production and theater management.

sido-muncul.name: Sido Muncul
sido-muncul.description: PT Industri Jamu dan Farmasi Sido Muncul Tbk, known as Sido Muncul, is an Indonesian herbal medicine and food products company based in Semarang. Established in 1940, it produces and markets herbal medication products such as the jamu Tolak Angin.

surya-semesta-internusa.name: Surya Semesta Internusa
surya-semesta-internusa.description: PT Surya Semesta Internusa Tbk is an Indonesian publicly traded construction company. It operates in property development and management, construction, and hospitality sectors. The company is involved in real estate and construction industries.

sm-culture-contents.name: SM Culture & Contents
sm-culture-contents.description: SM Culture & Contents is a South Korean company involved in advertising, production, travel, and talent management. It operates as a talent agency, television and theatrical production company, and travel company. The company is based in South Korea.

saponia.name: Saponia
saponia.description: Saponia is a Croatian company producing consumer goods and chemicals, including cleaning and hygiene products and supplements for household and industrial use. It is headquartered in Osijek.

sabeco.name: Sabeco
sabeco.description: Sabeco, officially Saigon Beer – Alcohol – Beverage Corporation, is Vietnam's leading beer producer. It was formerly under Vietnam's Ministry of Trade and Industry and is now a subsidiary of ThaiBev. Its main brands include Bia Saigon and 333 Beer.

sanima-bank.name: Sanima Bank
sanima-bank.description: Sanima Bank is a commercial bank in Nepal that started as a National Level Development Bank in 2004. It was licensed as an 'A' Class Commercial Bank in 2012 and operates 106 branches and 28 extension counters within and outside Kathmandu Valley.

spring-airlines.name: Spring Airlines
spring-airlines.description: Spring Airlines is a low-cost airline headquartered in Changning, Shanghai, China. It operates in the airline industry.

sunac-china.name: Sunac China
sunac-china.description: Sunac China Holdings Limited is a major property developer headquartered in Tianjin, China. The company focuses on large-scale, medium to high-end property developments across multiple Chinese cities including Beijing and Chongqing.

starflyer.name: StarFlyer
starflyer.description: Star Flyer Inc. is a Japanese airline headquartered at Kitakyushu Airport in Fukuoka Prefecture. It operates as a hybrid airline offering higher service levels than low-cost carriers but with lower operating costs than full-service carriers. It uses the IATA code 7G and domestically also MQ.

sierra-wireless.name: Sierra Wireless
sierra-wireless.description: Sierra Wireless is a Canadian multinational company headquartered in Richmond, British Columbia, that designs, manufactures, and provides wireless communications equipment and services. It maintains offices and operations in multiple countries including the United States, Korea, and Japan.

shikun-binui-ltd.name: Shikun & Binui Ltd.
shikun-binui-ltd.description: Shikun & Binui Ltd. is a global business group based in Israel operating through subsidiaries in infrastructure, real estate, energy, and concessions. Its subsidiaries operate in more than twenty countries worldwide. The company is involved in the construction industry.

steel-authority-of-india-limited.name: Steel Authority of India Limited
steel-authority-of-india-limited.description: Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL) is an Indian public sector steel manufacturing corporation based in New Delhi. It is designated as a Maharatna CPSE and is the largest government-owned steel producer in India. The company was incorporated on 24 January 1973 and operates under the Ministry of Steel.

softblue.name: SoftBlue
softblue.description: SoftBlue S.A. (InTechHouse) is a Polish technology company headquartered in Bydgoszcz and Dallas. Founded in 2003, it operates in IT, electronics, and telecommunications, serving enterprises and public institutions, and holds a research and development centre status from the Polish Ministry of Development and Technology.

skydance.name: Skydance
skydance.description: Skydance Corporation is an American multinational mass media and entertainment conglomerate headquartered in Midtown Manhattan, New York. It was formed through the merger of Skydance Media and Paramount Global in 2025 and later acquired Warner Bros. Discovery in 2026, adopting its current name.

sunoco.name: Sunoco
sunoco.description: Sunoco LP is an American vehicle gasoline master limited partnership headquartered in Dallas, Texas. Founded in 1886, it has transitioned from a vertically integrated energy company to a distributor of fuels and operator of energy infrastructure. It previously engaged in oil and gas exploration, refining, chemical manufacturing, and retail fuel sales.

stockland.name: Stockland
stockland.description: Stockland Corporation Limited is one of Australia's largest residential property development companies. It specializes in master-planned communities and owns and develops retail town centers, logistics, business parks, office assets, residential communities, and retirement living villages.

sega-sammy-holdings.name: Sega Sammy Holdings
sega-sammy-holdings.description: Sega Sammy Holdings Inc. is a Japanese global holding company formed in 2004 by merging Sega and Sammy Corporation. Both companies operate in the amusement industry. The conglomerate is headquartered in Japan.

sage-group.name: Sage Group
sage-group.description: The Sage Group plc is a British multinational enterprise software company headquartered in Newcastle upon Tyne. It develops accounting, financial management, payroll, and human-resources software mainly for small and medium-sized businesses. Its products include Sage 50, Sage Intacct, and Sage X3.

seadrill.name: Seadrill
seadrill.description: Seadrill is a Bermuda-based offshore drilling contractor providing worldwide drilling services to the oil and gas industry. It owns and operates drillships, semi-submersible rigs, and jack-up rigs for operations in various water depths and environments.

shanghai-pudong-development-bank.name: Shanghai Pudong Development Bank
shanghai-pudong-development-bank.description: Shanghai Pudong Development Bank, also known as SPD Bank, is a city-owned joint-stock commercial bank established in 1993. It is owned by the Shanghai Municipal Government and operates primarily in China.

science-applications-international-corpo.name: Science Applications International Corporation
science-applications-international-corpo.description: Science Applications International Corporation (SAIC) is an American technology company headquartered in Reston, Virginia. It provides government services and information technology support. SAIC focuses on delivering technology solutions primarily to government clients.

safeway.name: Safeway
safeway.description: Safeway, Inc. is an American supermarket chain operating primarily in the Western United States and some Mid-Atlantic locations. It offers grocery items, general merchandise, and specialty departments including bakery, delicatessen, floral, pharmacy, Starbucks coffee shops, and vehicle fuel centers.

sarepta-therapeutics.name: Sarepta Therapeutics
sarepta-therapeutics.description: Sarepta Therapeutics, Inc. is a medical research and drug development company based in Cambridge, Massachusetts. Founded in 1980 as AntiVirals, it changed its name to Sarepta Therapeutics in 2012. As of 2023, the company has four approved drugs.

singapore-stock-exchange.name: Singapore Stock Exchange
singapore-stock-exchange.description: Singapore Exchange Limited is a Singapore-based exchange conglomerate that operates equity, fixed income, currency, and commodity markets. It offers listing, trading, clearing, settlement, depository, and data services. SGX Group is a member of the World Federation of Exchanges and the Asian and Oceanian Stock Exchanges Federation.

sainsbury-s.name: Sainsbury's
sainsbury-s.description: J Sainsbury plc, trading as Sainsbury's, is a British supermarket chain and the second-largest in the United Kingdom.

sekisui-house.name: Sekisui House
sekisui-house.description: Sekisui House, Ltd. is a Japanese homebuilder and real estate developer headquartered in Osaka. Founded in 1960, it constructs custom-built houses, rental housing, condominiums, and also engages in remodeling and urban development.

shanghai-construction-group.name: Shanghai Construction Group
shanghai-construction-group.description: Shanghai Construction (Group) Corporation is a Chinese construction and engineering company. It is ranked as the 16th largest construction company in the world based on 2011 revenues. The company operates in the civil engineering sector.

synaptics.name: Synaptics
synaptics.description: Synaptics, Inc. is an American technology company based in San Jose, California, specializing in computer-to-human interface devices. It develops touchpads, fingerprint biometrics, and other technologies for laptops, smartphones, smart home devices, wearables, and automobiles. Synaptics sells its products to original equipment manufacturers and display manufacturers.

sands-china.name: Sands China
sands-china.description: Sands China Limited is an integrated resort developer and operator based in Macau. It is a majority-owned subsidiary of Las Vegas Sands Corporation and operates in the tourism industry.

shenghe-resources.name: Shenghe Resources
shenghe-resources.description: Shenghe Resources is a Chinese partly state-owned company specializing in rare earths mining and processing. Founded in 1998, it is listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange. The Ministry of Natural Resources is its largest shareholder, and it is affiliated with Aluminum Corporation of China, which influences its strategic decisions.

senao-international.name: Senao International
senao-international.description: Senao International, Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese distributor of cellular phones, smartphones, tablets, notebooks, game consoles, and related accessories. Founded in 1979, it is a public company listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange and a subsidiary of Chunghwa Telecom. Senao International holds over 50% market share as the largest cellular phone distributor in Taiwan.

sk-innovation.name: SK Innovation
sk-innovation.description: SK Innovation Co., Ltd. is a South Korean intermediate holding company of SK Group engaged in petroleum, alternative energy, and oil exploration. It operates through six major subsidiaries including SK Energy and SK On.

snap-on.name: Snap-on
snap-on.description: Snap-on Incorporated is a United States company that designs, manufactures, and markets high-end tools and equipment for professional use in the transportation industry. It is headquartered in Kenosha, Wisconsin, and has been since 1930. Snap-on also distributes lower-end tools under the Blue-Point brand.

sumitomo-rubber-industries.name: Sumitomo Rubber Industries
sumitomo-rubber-industries.description: Sumitomo Rubber Industries, Ltd. is a global tire and rubber company based in Japan and part of the Sumitomo Group. It produces a wide range of rubber products including automobile tires and sports equipment under brands such as Dunlop, Falken, Srixon, and Cleveland Golf.

state-bank-of-para.name: State Bank of Para
state-bank-of-para.description: Banpará is a Brazilian regional bank founded in 1959 by the Pará state government. It primarily supports the banking needs of the state government and its employees. The bank operates regionally within Brazil.

samsung-asset-management.name: Samsung Asset Management
samsung-asset-management.description: Samsung Asset Management Co., Ltd. is a South Korean asset management company headquartered in Seoul. It is a subsidiary of Samsung Life Insurance and the largest asset management company in South Korea.

siam-cement.name: Siam Cement
siam-cement.description: The Siam Cement Public Company Limited is the largest and oldest cement and building material company in Thailand and Southeast Asia. Its major shareholder is King Vajiralongkorn, owning 30 percent of shares.

santos-brasil.name: Santos Brasil
santos-brasil.description: Santos Brasil Participações S/A is a Brazilian logistics company headquartered in São Paulo. It operates container terminals including Tecon Santos, the largest container handler in Brazil and Latin America, and manages several other terminals and distribution centers.

santen-pharmaceutical.name: Santen Pharmaceutical
santen-pharmaceutical.description: Santen Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. is a Japanese pharmaceutical company specializing in ophthalmology. It holds the top market share in Japan for ophthalmic products and sells its products in over 50 countries worldwide.

sm-energy.name: SM Energy
sm-energy.description: SM Energy Company is engaged in hydrocarbon exploration and is headquartered in Denver, Colorado. It is organized in Delaware and operates in the petroleum industry.

supor.name: Supor
supor.description: Supor, officially Zhejiang Supor Co., Ltd., is a Chinese cookware and small appliances company headquartered in Hangzhou, Zhejiang. Founded in 1994, it was the largest cookware company in China in 2006. That year, French company Groupe SEB acquired Supor, which was the first Chinese cookware company listed on a stock market.

sofi.name: SoFi
sofi.description: SoFi Technologies, Inc. is an American financial technology company founded in 2011 by Stanford graduates as a student loan refinancer. It operates a direct bank serving retail customers and businesses and is the largest U.S.-based online lender.

sunny-optical-technology-group-company-l.name: Sunny Optical Technology (Group) Company Limited
sunny-optical-technology-group-company-l.description: Sunny Optical Technology (Group) Company Limited is a Chinese civilian-run enterprise that produces optical lenses. It is a listed company operating in China. The company is known simply as Sunny Optical or Sunny.

springland-international.name: Springland International
springland-international.description: Springland International Holdings Ltd is a Chinese retail company operating primarily in the Yangtze River Delta. It runs department stores and supermarkets and is traded on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. The company focuses on retail chain operations.

shine-lawyers.name: Shine Lawyers
shine-lawyers.description: Shine Lawyers is an Australian law firm specializing in personal injury compensation law. It operates on a no win no fee basis and has expanded into toxic exposure, silica and dust disease, abuse, and medical negligence services through acquisitions.

softcat.name: Softcat
softcat.description: Softcat is a UK-based IT infrastructure provider founded in 1993 and headquartered in Marlow. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 250 Index. It provides IT infrastructure services.

samco.name: SAMCO
samco.description: SAMCO Inc. is a Japanese company headquartered in Kyoto that manufactures and sells semiconductor process equipment. Its products include plasma etching systems, plasma deposition systems, and surface treatment systems.

sciquest.name: SciQuest
sciquest.description: JAGGAER, formerly SciQuest, is a cloud-based, AI-enabled procurement software and spend management company headquartered in Durham, North Carolina. Founded in 1995, it offers sourcing, contract management, spend analysis, e-procurement, invoicing, payments, and supplier management solutions and formed its current structure after merging with Pool4Tool and BravoSolution in 2017.

silgan-holdings.name: Silgan Holdings
silgan-holdings.description: Silgan Holdings Inc. is an American manufacturing company based in Connecticut that produces consumer goods packaging. Founded in 1987 by two former executives of Continental Can, the company name is derived from their names. It operates in the product packaging industry.

silicon-graphics-international.name: Silicon Graphics International
silicon-graphics-international.description: Silicon Graphics International Corp. was an American manufacturer of computer hardware and software, including high-performance computing systems and x86-based servers. Founded as Rackable Systems in 1999, it adopted the SGI name in 2009 after acquiring Silicon Graphics Inc. out of bankruptcy.

sparebank-1-ntterytnsberg.name: SpareBank 1 Nøtterøy–Tønsberg
sparebank-1-ntterytnsberg.description: SpareBank 1 Nøtterøy–Tønsberg was a Norwegian savings bank headquartered in Nøtterøy, Norway, with its main market in Vestfold. The bank's history dates back to June 20, 1857, with the establishment of the first savings bank in Nøtterøy.

sps-commerce.name: SPS Commerce
sps-commerce.description: SPS Commerce, Inc. is a technology and application software company based in the United States that provides cloud-based supply chain management software. Headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota, it also has offices in the US and internationally in multiple cities worldwide.

spanish-broadcasting-system.name: Spanish Broadcasting System
spanish-broadcasting-system.description: Spanish Broadcasting System, Inc. is a U.S.-based media company specializing in Spanish-speaking audiences. It is one of the largest owners and operators of radio stations in the United States and also has investments in television and internet properties.

sandy-spring-bank.name: Sandy Spring Bank
sandy-spring-bank.description: Sandy Spring Bancorp, Inc. was a bank holding company headquartered in Olney, Maryland, serving the Washington metropolitan area. It offered banking, insurance, and wealth management services. In April 2025, it was acquired by Atlantic Union Bank.

sjw-group.name: SJW Group
sjw-group.description: SJW Group, also known as H2O America, is a water utility company based in San Jose, California. It processes, distributes, and supplies water to over 1 million residents in California and about 60,000 people in Texas. The company serves a total of approximately 245,000 connections across these regions.

seagen.name: Seagen
seagen.description: Seagen Inc. is a biotechnology company based in Bothell, Washington, focused on developing monoclonal antibody-based therapies for cancer treatment. It is known for its antibody-drug conjugates technology, which targets cancer cells while reducing toxic effects on non-targeted cells.

samhwa-networks.name: Samhwa Networks
samhwa-networks.description: Samhwa Networks is a Korean drama production company founded in 1980 by Shin Hyun-taek. It started as a home video distributor and later became known for its drama productions. The company is based in South Korea.

sartorius-ag.name: Sartorius AG
sartorius-ag.description: Sartorius AG is an international supplier of pharmaceutical and laboratory equipment headquartered in Göttingen, Germany. Founded in 1870, it operates through two divisions: Bioprocess Solutions and Lab Products & Services.

smcp-group.name: SMCP Group
smcp-group.description: SMCP Group is a French holding company specializing in accessible luxury ready-to-wear fashion. Headquartered in Paris, it was formed in 2010 through the merger of Sandro, Maje, and Claudie Pierlot. The company operates over 1,600 points of sale in 43 countries and includes the subsidiary De Fursac.

sfc-energy.name: SFC Energy
sfc-energy.description: SFC Energy is a German manufacturer of direct methanol and hydrogen fuel cells based in Brunnthal near Munich. The company develops solutions for off-grid and stationary power generation, including voltage converters and switching power supplies. It has production sites in Germany, the Netherlands, Romania, and Canada.

syneos-health.name: Syneos Health
syneos-health.description: Syneos Health is an American company based in Morrisville, North Carolina, providing contract research and commercial services to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies. It specializes in late-stage clinical trials and commercial services to market health treatments.

supermicro.name: Supermicro
supermicro.description: Super Micro Computer, Inc., known as Supermicro, is an American IT company based in San Jose, California. It produces high-performance servers, server management software, and storage systems for markets such as enterprise data centers, cloud computing, AI, 5G, and edge computing.

sabesp.name: Sabesp
sabesp.description: Sabesp is a Brazilian water and waste management company headquartered in São Paulo. It provides water and sewage services to residential, commercial, and industrial users in São Paulo and 363 municipalities under long-term concession contracts. It is the largest water and waste management company in Latin America.

splunk-inc.name: Splunk Inc.
splunk-inc.description: Splunk Inc. is a subsidiary of Cisco Systems producing software for indexing, searching, and analyzing machine-generated data. Its products support cyber security and observability through dashboards, alerts, and reports. Splunk offers on-premises software and SaaS solutions.

scentre-group.name: Scentre Group
scentre-group.description: Scentre Group Limited is a shopping centre company operating retail destinations under the Westfield brand in Australia and New Zealand. It manages ownership, development, design, and leasing of its centres. The group was formed in 2014 after separating from the Westfield Group's American and European businesses.

stitch-fix.name: Stitch Fix
stitch-fix.description: Stitch Fix, Inc. is an online personal styling service based in San Francisco, California. It combines human stylists with AI tools to recommend clothing and accessories based on fit, budget, and style. The company was founded in 2011 and went public in 2017.

sany-heavy-industry-co-ltd.name: SANY Heavy Industry Co., Ltd
sany-heavy-industry-co-ltd.description: Sany Heavy Industry Co., Ltd. is a Chinese multinational heavy equipment manufacturer headquartered in Changsha, Hunan. It is the third-largest heavy equipment maker globally and the first in China to enter the FT Global 500 and Forbes Global 2000.

s-oil.name: S-Oil
s-oil.description: S-Oil Corporation is a petroleum and refinery company headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. Established in 1976, it produces petroleum, petrochemical, and lubricant products and was listed in the Fortune Global 500 in 2009.

sprinklr.name: Sprinklr
sprinklr.description: Sprinklr is an American software company that develops a SaaS customer experience management platform. Its software integrates applications for social media marketing, advertising, content management, collaboration, and customer care. The company is based in the United States.

sweetgreen.name: Sweetgreen
sweetgreen.description: Sweetgreen is an American fast casual restaurant chain specializing in salads and grain bowls. Founded in 2006, it opened its first store in Washington, D.C. shortly after its founders graduated from Georgetown University. The company operates in the United States.

shanghai-shentong-metro-group-co-ltd.name: Shanghai Shentong Metro Group Co., Ltd.
shanghai-shentong-metro-group-co-ltd.legal_name: Shanghai Shentong Metro Group Co., Ltd.
shanghai-shentong-metro-group-co-ltd.description: Shanghai Shentong Metro Group Co., Ltd. operates the Shanghai Metro and Shanghai Maglev systems. It manages investment, financing, and operations, owning most of the network's assets. The company is named after Shanghai and its transportation function.

listings.name: Shanghai Shentong Metro Group Co., Ltd.

solaredge.name: SolarEdge
solaredge.description: SolarEdge Technologies, Inc. is an Israeli company producing DC optimized inverter systems. Founded in 2006, it began mass production in 2009 and went public on Nasdaq in 2015. In 2023, it was removed from the S&P 500 after being the worst performing stock in the index that year.

sealink-travel-group.name: SeaLink Travel Group
sealink-travel-group.description: Kelsian Group Limited, formerly SeaLink Travel Group, is an Australian public company operating transport services in Australia, the UK, Jersey, the USA, and Singapore. It provides various transport services across these regions.

suning-com.name: Suning.com
suning-com.description: Suning.com Co., Ltd. is a major Chinese retailer headquartered in Nanjing, Jiangsu. It operates over 10,000 stores nationwide and its e-commerce platform ranks among the top three Chinese B2C companies. Suning.com was listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2004 and ranked 328th on the Fortune Global 500 list in 2021.

stanley-gibbons.name: Stanley Gibbons
stanley-gibbons.description: The Stanley Gibbons Group plc is a London-incorporated company specializing in retailing collectible postage stamps and related products. It is a major stamp dealer and philatelic publisher with a subsidiary that held a royal warrant from Queen Elizabeth II.

sucampo-pharmaceuticals.name: Sucampo Pharmaceuticals
sucampo-pharmaceuticals.description: Sucampo Pharmaceuticals, Inc. was a pharmaceutical company headquartered in Rockville, Maryland, focusing on gastroenterology, ophthalmology, and oncology-related disorders. The company was acquired by Mallinckrodt in 2018.

standard-biotools-inc.name: Standard BioTools Inc.
standard-biotools-inc.description: Standard BioTools Inc., formerly Fluidigm Corp., is an American life science tools company. It offers analytical mass cytometry systems for flow cytometry and tissue imaging, automated genomic analysis instruments, microfluidic arrays, and associated reagents and services.

saudi-arabian-fertilizer-company.name: Saudi Arabian Fertilizer Company
saudi-arabian-fertilizer-company.description: Saudi Arabian Fertilizer Company (SAFCO) is the first petrochemical company in Saudi Arabia, established in 1965. It is one of the largest chemical producers globally, with SABIC owning 42.99% and the rest held by private and public sectors.

seachange-international.name: SeaChange International
seachange-international.description: SeaChange International, Inc. is a global supplier of video delivery software based in the United States. It provides video streaming, linear TV, and video advertising technology for operators, content owners, and broadcasters worldwide.

stx-entertainment.name: STX Entertainment
stx-entertainment.description: STX Financing, LLC is an American independent entertainment and media company founded in 2014. The studio produces film, television, and digital media projects.

spire-global.name: Spire Global
spire-global.description: Spire Global, Inc. is a space-to-cloud data and analytics company based in the United States. It specializes in tracking global data sets using a constellation of nanosatellites, including maritime, aviation, and weather patterns.

synageva.name: Synageva
synageva.description: Synageva BioPharma Corp. was a biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Lexington, Massachusetts, focused on medicines for rare diseases. It had manufacturing and laboratory locations in Massachusetts and Georgia, as well as offices worldwide.

south-indian-bank.name: South Indian Bank
south-indian-bank.description: The South Indian Bank Limited is an Indian private-sector bank headquartered in Thrissur, Kerala. Established during the Swadeshi movement, it transitioned from a private limited to a public limited company in 1939 and offers retail, corporate banking, para banking, treasury, and foreign exchange services.

south32.name: South32
south32.description: South32 Limited is a mining and metals company headquartered in Perth, Western Australia. It was spun out of BHP Billiton in 2015 and is listed on the Australian Securities Exchange with secondary listings in Johannesburg and London.

sinotrans-limited.name: Sinotrans Limited
sinotrans-limited.description: Sinotrans Limited is one of the largest logistics companies in China. Its business includes storage and terminal services, trucking, and marine transportation.

samart-group.name: Samart Group
samart-group.description: Samart Group is a Thai conglomerate focusing on telecommunications and consumer electronics. It is the parent company of Samart Corporation, Samart I-Mobile, and Samart Telecom, and is listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand.

springer-nature.name: Springer Nature
springer-nature.description: Springer Nature is a German-British academic publishing company created in May 2015. It was formed by merging Springer Science+Business Media with Holtzbrinck Publishing Group's Nature Publishing Group, Palgrave Macmillan, and Macmillan Education.

samsung-sdi.name: Samsung SDI
samsung-sdi.description: Samsung SDI Co., Ltd. is a South Korean battery and electronic materials manufacturer headquartered in Yongin, Gyeonggi-do. It operates Energy Solutions and Electronic Materials segments producing rechargeable batteries and semiconductor materials. In 2022, it ranked sixth worldwide in battery market share.

strauss-group-ltd.name: Strauss Group Ltd.
strauss-group-ltd.description: Strauss Group Ltd. is an Israeli manufacturer and marketer of consumer foods sold through retail stores. It is one of the largest food manufacturers in Israel and focuses on dairy, coffee, water, snacks, salads, and dips. The company is publicly traded on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange.

sibanye-stillwater.name: Sibanye-Stillwater
sibanye-stillwater.description: Sibanye-Stillwater is a global mining and metals processing group with operations, projects, and investments across five continents. The group is also involved in recycling various metals and holds interests in secondary mining operations.

segro.name: Segro
segro.description: SEGRO plc is a British property investment and development company based in London. It develops and invests in properties in the UK and Continental Europe, focusing on areas around cities and transport hubs. The company became a Real Estate Investment Trust in 2007 and is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

spx-technologies.name: SPX Technologies
spx-technologies.description: SPX Technologies, Inc. is an American manufacturing company headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. It operates in HVAC, detection and measurement, power transmission and generation, and engineered solutions markets. The company has a global presence with operations in 17 countries and sales in 100 countries.

sinch.name: Sinch
sinch.description: Sinch AB, formerly CLX Communications, is a communications platform as a service company headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. It powers messaging, voice, and email communications between businesses and customers. The company employs over 4000 people in more than 60 countries.

sumco.name: SUMCO
sumco.description: SUMCO Corporation is a Japanese semiconductor company that manufactures silicon wafers for semiconductor manufacturers worldwide.

saipem.name: Saipem
saipem.description: Saipem S.p.A. is an Italian multinational oilfield services company and one of the largest globally. It was a subsidiary of Italian oil and gas supermajor Eni until 2016, which still holds about 30% of Saipem's shares.

sanden-corporation.name: Sanden Corporation
sanden-corporation.description: Sanden Corporation is a Japanese company based in Isesaki, Gunma. It manufactures automotive and electrical equipment and is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

silicon-laboratories.name: Silicon Laboratories
silicon-laboratories.description: Silicon Laboratories, Inc., known as Silicon Labs, is a fabless global technology company based in the United States. It designs and manufactures semiconductors, silicon devices, and software for electronics design engineers and manufacturers in the Internet of Things infrastructure worldwide.

sinclair-broadcast-group.name: Sinclair Broadcast Group
sinclair-broadcast-group.description: Sinclair Broadcast Group, headquartered in Cockeysville, Maryland, is an American telecommunications conglomerate. It is the second-largest television station operator in the United States, owning or operating 193 stations across over 100 markets and covering 40% of American households.

sunsoft.name: Sunsoft
sunsoft.description: Sun Corporation is a Japanese electronics manufacturer and video game developer and publisher. It is known for its video games produced under the Sunsoft division.

starbreeze-studios.name: Starbreeze Studios
starbreeze-studios.description: Starbreeze AB is a Swedish video game developer and publisher based in Stockholm. Founded by members of the demogroup Triton, it is known for games like The Chronicles of Riddick: Escape from Butcher Bay and Payday 2, and has experienced financial challenges and restructuring.

synopsys.name: Synopsys
synopsys.description: Synopsys, Inc. is an American multinational electronic design automation company headquartered in Sunnyvale, California. It provides tools and services for the design and verification of silicon chips and electronic systems. In 2024, it was ranked as the 12th largest software company globally.

st-jude-medical.name: St. Jude Medical
st-jude-medical.description: St. Jude Medical, Inc. was an American global medical device company headquartered in Little Canada, Minnesota. It operated more than 20 manufacturing facilities worldwide and sold products in over 100 countries. The company was named after Jude the Apostle.

suncorp-group.name: Suncorp Group
suncorp-group.description: Suncorp Group Limited is an Australian general insurance corporation based in Brisbane, Queensland. Formed in 1996 by merging Suncorp, Metway Bank, and QIDC, it was one of Australia's mid-sized banks until 2022 and is the largest general insurance group in the country.

signature-bank.name: Signature Bank
signature-bank.description: Signature Bank was an American full-service commercial bank headquartered in New York City with offices in several states. It offered banking products and specialized services for industries such as commercial real estate, private equity, and venture banking. The bank also had subsidiaries providing equipment financing and investment services.

sinovel.name: Sinovel
sinovel.description: Sinovel Wind Group Company is a Chinese state-owned manufacturer of wind turbines headquartered in Beijing. It operates in the wind power industry.

swala-gas-and-oil.name: Swala Gas and Oil
swala-gas-and-oil.description: Swala Gas and Oil is a Tanzanian oil and gas exploration company headquartered in Dar es Salaam. Incorporated in 2011, it holds exploration licenses for the Kilosa-Kilombero and Pangani fields in the East African Rift. It is a subsidiary of Swala Energy and trades on the Dar es Salaam Stock Exchange.

sunrise-bank-limited.name: Sunrise Bank Limited
