sunrise-bank-limited.description: Laxmi Sunrise Bank Limited is a commercial bank in Nepal with its head office in Kathmandu. It is an 'A' class bank licensed by Nepal Rastra Bank and has branches nationwide. The bank's shares are publicly traded on the Nepal Stock Exchange.

sjvn.name: SJVN
sjvn.description: SJVN is an Indian public sector undertaking involved in hydroelectric power generation and transmission. Incorporated in 1988 as Nathpa Jhakri Power Corporation, it operates three hydropower plants and also has wind and solar power capacities.

sony-financial-holdings.name: Sony Financial Holdings
sony-financial-holdings.description: Sony Financial Group Inc., formerly Sony Financial Holdings Inc., is a Japanese holding company based in Tokyo. It operates businesses including life and non-life insurance, online banking, credit card settlement, nursing care, and venture capital. The company is part of the financial services sector in Japan.

singapore-press-holdings.name: Singapore Press Holdings
singapore-press-holdings.description: Singapore Press Holdings Limited (SPH) was a state media company in Singapore that published The Straits Times and other newspapers. It also operated radio, television, and digital media platforms. SPH was one of the two main state media companies in Singapore.

snap-inc.name: Snap Inc.
snap-inc.description: Snap Inc. is an American technology company headquartered in Santa Monica, California. Founded in 2011, it develops and maintains products such as Snapchat, Spectacles, and Bitmoji. The company was rebranded from Snapchat Inc. to Snap Inc. in 2016.

spelling-television.name: Spelling Television
spelling-television.description: Spelling Television Inc. was an American television production company founded by Aaron Spelling in 1965. It produced popular TV shows and is now an in-name-only unit of CBS Studios, with its library owned by CBS' parent company Skydance.

sarcos.name: Sarcos
sarcos.description: Palladyne AI Corp., formerly Sarcos Research Corporation founded in 1983, is an American company that developed robots. In 2023, it shifted focus to AI software for robotic applications and changed its name to Palladyne AI in 2024.

sanonda.name: Sanonda
sanonda.description: Hubei Sanonda Co., Ltd. is a Chinese pesticide producer based in Jingzhou, Hubei Province. ChemChina and Adama Agricultural Solutions together owned 30.75% as of 2016, with additional ownership by the Government of Qichun County.

sg-automotive.name: SG Automotive
sg-automotive.description: SG Automotive Group Co Ltd is a Chinese vehicle and component manufacturer based in Dandong, Liaoning province. It produces buses, light trucks, semi-trailer trucks, SUVs, and automotive components used by other Chinese car makers.

starlux-airlines.name: Starlux Airlines
starlux-airlines.description: Starlux Airlines is a Taiwanese full service carrier headquartered in Taipei. Established in 2018 by Chang Kuo-wei, it operates from its hub at Taoyuan International Airport. Starlux is one of three major international airlines in Taiwan alongside China Airlines and EVA Air.

simmons-bank.name: Simmons Bank
simmons-bank.description: Simmons Bank operates in several US states including Arkansas and Texas. It is the main subsidiary of Simmons First National Corporation, a bank holding company.

syncona.name: Syncona
syncona.description: Syncona is a British closed-ended investment trust dedicated to life science investments. Co-founded in 2012 and publicly listed on the London Stock Exchange, it is a constituent of the FTSE 250 Index.

spacecom.name: Spacecom
spacecom.description: Spacecom, or Space Communication, is an Israeli communications satellite operator headquartered in Ramat Gan, Israel. It operates multiple satellites across orbital positions in the Middle East, European Union, and North America. The company is part of the telecommunications industry.

skullcandy.name: Skullcandy
skullcandy.description: Skullcandy Inc. is an American company based in Park City, Utah. It markets technology products including headphones, earphones, and Bluetooth speakers.

sanan-optoelectronics.name: San’an Optoelectronics
sanan-optoelectronics.description: Sanan Optoelectronics is a publicly listed Chinese company that manufactures full-color high-brightness LED wafers and chips. It also produces solar cells and PIN photodetectors, operating in the optoelectronics industry.

steyr-motors.name: Steyr Motors
steyr-motors.description: Steyr Motors is an Austrian manufacturer of diesel engines based in Steyr, Upper Austria.

sanne-group.name: Sanne Group
sanne-group.description: Sanne Group is a provider of asset management services based in Jersey. It was listed on the London Stock Exchange and part of the FTSE 250 Index until its acquisition by Apex Group in August 2022.

sociedad-quimica-y-minera-de-chile.name: Sociedad Química y Minera de Chile
sociedad-quimica-y-minera-de-chile.legal_name: Sociedad Química y Minera de Chile
sociedad-quimica-y-minera-de-chile.description: Sociedad Química y Minera de Chile (SQM) is a Chilean chemical company supplying plant nutrients, iodine, lithium, and industrial chemicals. It was the world's largest lithium producer by 2017. In 2023, its lithium mining activities were transferred to Nova Andino Litio, a public–private joint venture with Codelco.

listings.name: Sociedad Química y Minera de Chile

studio-dragon.name: Studio Dragon
studio-dragon.description: Studio Dragon Corporation is a South Korean drama production, marketing, and distribution company under CJ ENM Entertainment Division. Established in 2016 as a spin-off from E&M's drama division, it became a subsidiary of CJ ENM in 2018 after a corporate merger.

stepan-company.name: Stepan Company
stepan-company.description: Stepan Company is an American manufacturer of specialty chemicals headquartered in Northbrook, Illinois. Founded in 1932, it is known as the largest global merchant manufacturer of anionic surfactants used in detergents, shampoos, toothpastes, and cosmetics.

seiko.name: Seiko
seiko.description: Seiko Group Corporation is a Japanese company known for making watches, clocks, electronic devices, and semiconductors. Founded in 1881 in Tokyo, Seiko introduced the world's first commercial quartz wristwatch in 1969.

sun-pharmaceutical.name: Sun Pharmaceutical
sun-pharmaceutical.description: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited is an Indian multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Mumbai. It manufactures and sells pharmaceutical formulations and active pharmaceutical ingredients in over 100 countries. It is the largest pharmaceutical company in India.

ses-s-a.name: SES S.A.
ses-s-a.description: SES S.A. is a Luxembourgish communications satellite operator providing video and data connectivity worldwide. Its clients include broadcasters, content and internet service providers, network operators, governments, and institutions.

sbf-120.name: SBF 120
sbf-120.description: The SBF 120 is a French stock market index based on the 120 most actively traded stocks listed in Paris. It includes all stocks in the CAC 40 and CAC Next 20 indexes plus 60 additional stocks listed on Euronext Paris.

semtech-corporation.name: Semtech Corporation
semtech-corporation.description: Semtech Corporation is an American supplier of analog and mixed-signal semiconductors and advanced algorithms for consumer, enterprise computing, communications, and industrial markets. It is based in Camarillo, Southern California, and was founded in 1960 in Newbury Park, California.

smartfren.name: Smartfren
smartfren.description: Smartfren is an Indonesian wireless network operator headquartered in Central Jakarta. Operated by XLSMART, a joint venture of Sinar Mas and Axiata, it runs 4G LTE and 5G networks after shifting from CDMA in 2014. As of 2018, it had 10.1 million active subscribers.

servcorp.name: Servcorp
servcorp.description: Servcorp Limited is an Australian multinational office services company founded in 1978. It provides serviced offices, virtual offices, and coworking spaces across multiple international markets. The company is based in Australia.

shionogi.name: Shionogi
shionogi.description: Shionogi & Company, Limited is a Japanese pharmaceutical company known for developing Crestor. It operates in the medical supply industry and uses katakana (シオノギ) as its brand name. The company is based in Japan.

shutterstock.name: Shutterstock
shutterstock.description: Shutterstock, Inc. is an American provider of stock photography, footage, music, and editing tools headquartered in New York. Founded in 2002, it maintains a large library of royalty-free media and expanded pricing options in 2008. The company was publicly traded and planned a merger with Getty Images that was later cancelled.

sibir-energy.name: Sibir Energy
sibir-energy.description: Sibir Energy was a British oil company focused on petroleum and natural gas exploration in Siberia, Russia. It became a wholly owned subsidiary of Gazprom Neft in 2011 and was completely liquidated as a separate company in 2016.

sinovac-biotech.name: Sinovac Biotech
sinovac-biotech.description: Sinovac Biotech Ltd. is a Chinese biopharmaceutical company based in Beijing that develops and commercializes vaccines against infectious diseases. It was listed on Nasdaq but had trading halted in 2019 due to a proxy fight. The company has faced bribery probes and disinformation campaigns related to its COVID-19 vaccine.

soco-international.name: SOCO International
soco-international.description: Pharos Energy Plc, formerly SOCO International, is a London-headquartered oil and gas exploration and production company. It changed its name in 2019 following controversy over illegal activities in Virunga. The company operates in the petroleum industry.

soitec.name: Soitec
soitec.description: Soitec is a French multinational corporation that manufactures substrates used in semiconductor manufacturing. The company operates in the electronic components manufacturing industry and is based in France.

sonos.name: Sonos
sonos.description: Sonos, Inc. is an American audio equipment manufacturer headquartered in Santa Barbara, California. Founded in 2002 by four individuals, the company specializes in smart speakers and related audio products.

spirit-aerosystems.name: Spirit AeroSystems
spirit-aerosystems.description: Spirit AeroSystems Holdings, Inc. is an American manufacturer of aerostructures for commercial airplanes headquartered in Wichita, Kansas. Wholly owned by Boeing, it produces fuselage and flight deck sections for Boeing and Airbus aircraft. Its competitors include Collins Aerospace and Kawasaki Heavy Industries.

synovus.name: Synovus
synovus.description: Synovus Financial Corp. is a financial services firm based in Columbus, Georgia. It provides commercial and retail banking, investment, and mortgage services through branches and ATMs in several southeastern U.S. states. The company was formerly known as the Columbus Bank and Trust Company.

st-engineering.name: ST Engineering
st-engineering.description: ST Engineering, or Singapore Technologies Engineering, is a Singapore-based multinational technology, defence, and engineering group. It has a diverse portfolio across aerospace, smart city, defence, and public security segments. The company is headquartered in Singapore.

stericycle.name: Stericycle
stericycle.description: Stericycle, Inc. is an American compliance company specializing in collecting and disposing of regulated medical waste, including sharps, pharmaceuticals, and pathological waste. Founded in 1989, it is headquartered in Bannockburn, Illinois, with operations in North America and Europe.

sonic-focus.name: Sonic Focus
sonic-focus.description: Sonic Focus Inc was a software development company based in South Lake Tahoe, California, founded in 1995. It developed audio post-processing technologies to enhance sound quality in various electronic products, including mobile phones, car audio, PCs, and home theatre systems.

spirax-group-plc.name: Spirax Group plc
spirax-group-plc.description: Spirax Group plc is a British manufacturer of steam management systems, peristaltic pumps, and related fluid path technologies. Headquartered in Cheltenham, England, it is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index.

sumitomo-forestry.name: Sumitomo Forestry
sumitomo-forestry.description: Sumitomo Forestry is a Japanese company engaged in logging, processing, and constructing houses made of wooden materials. It is part of the Sumitomo Group keiretsu.

sumitomo-realty-development.name: Sumitomo Realty & Development
sumitomo-realty-development.description: Sumitomo Realty & Development Co., Ltd. is a Japanese real estate development company headquartered in Shinjuku, Tokyo. It is a member of the Sumitomo Group.

saudi-awwal-bank.name: Saudi Awwal Bank
saudi-awwal-bank.description: Saudi Awwal Bank (SAB) is a Riyadh-based Saudi joint stock company with HSBC owning a minority stake. It originated from the British Bank of the Middle East acquired by HSBC in 1959. The bank was created in 1978 as Saudi Arab British Bank to manage HSBC branches and assets in Saudi Arabia due to foreign ownership restrictions.

shanghai-commercial-and-savings-bank.name: Shanghai Commercial and Savings Bank
shanghai-commercial-and-savings-bank.description: The Shanghai Commercial and Savings Bank is a bank headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan. It operates in the banking sector providing financial services.

sanmina-corporation.name: Sanmina Corporation
sanmina-corporation.description: Sanmina Corporation is an American electronics manufacturing services provider headquartered in San Jose, California. It serves OEMs in communications and computer hardware and operates nearly 80 manufacturing sites. It is among the largest independent manufacturers of printed circuit boards and backplanes.

shophq.name: ShopHQ
shophq.description: ShopHQ is an American e-commerce retailer and digital shopping platform owned by The Arena Group. It has operated for over 30 years as a multi-channel retailer including a national home shopping television network and an e-commerce website. The company is based in the United States.

sabre-corporation.name: Sabre Corporation
sabre-corporation.description: Sabre Corporation is a travel technology company headquartered in Southlake, Texas. It operates the Sabre Global Distribution System, the largest global distribution system for air bookings, connecting travel suppliers with travel sellers and providing real-time availability and pricing.

shufersal-ltd.name: Shufersal Ltd.
shufersal-ltd.description: Shufersal is the largest supermarket chain in Israel, established in 1958. It was the first company to implement the American supermarket model in Israel and holds a 20% market share in the country.

scandinavian-tobacco-group.name: Scandinavian Tobacco Group
scandinavian-tobacco-group.description: Scandinavian Tobacco Group is a Danish manufacturer of cigars and traditional pipe tobacco headquartered in Copenhagen. It is a publicly listed company on Nasdaq Copenhagen.

skistar.name: Skistar
skistar.description: SkiStar AB is a Swedish company focused on leisure, tourism, property, and retail, listed on the Stockholm Stock Exchange. Its core business includes alpine skiing in Sweden and Norway, along with accommodation, ski schools, and rental services.

smith-wesson.name: Smith & Wesson
smith-wesson.description: Smith & Wesson Brands, Inc. is an American firearm manufacturer headquartered in Maryville, Tennessee. The company operates in the arms industry.

sma-solar-technology.name: SMA Solar Technology
sma-solar-technology.description: SMA Solar Technology AG is a German company founded in 1981 and headquartered in Niestetal, Northern Hesse. It produces and manufactures solar inverters for photovoltaic systems used in grid connection, off-grid power supply, and backup operations.

ss-c-advent.name: SS&C Advent
ss-c-advent.description: SS&C Advent is a business unit of SS&C Technologies that provides portfolio management and accounting software to investment managers, hedge funds, family offices, and wealth management firms. Founded in San Francisco in 1983, it was acquired and rebranded by SS&C Technologies in 2015.

siemens-healthineers.name: Siemens Healthineers
siemens-healthineers.description: Siemens Healthineers is a German multinational company specializing in medical technology and imaging. It was spun off from Siemens in 2017, which retains a 67% stake. The company is headquartered in Erlangen, Germany.

steelcase.name: Steelcase
steelcase.description: Steelcase Inc. is a company headquartered in Grand Rapids, Michigan, United States, that designs, manufactures, and sells office and residential furniture. It also conducts research on workplace design and behavior to inform its product development.

sunbelt-rentals.name: Sunbelt Rentals
sunbelt-rentals.description: Sunbelt Rentals Holdings, Inc. is an industrial equipment rental company with dual headquarters in London, England and South Carolina, United States. It was listed on the London Stock Exchange and was part of the FTSE 100 Index before transferring its listing to the US in 2026.

sappi.name: Sappi
sappi.description: Sappi Limited is a South African pulp and paper company originally incorporated in 1936 as South African Pulp and Paper Industries Limited. It operates globally in the pulp and paper industry.

shinhan-bank.name: Shinhan Bank
shinhan-bank.description: Shinhan Bank Co., Ltd. is a South Korean bank headquartered in Seoul. Founded in 1982, it merged with Chohung Bank in 2006 and traces its origins to Hanseong Bank, one of Korea's first banks. It is part of the Shinhan Financial Group, which also includes Jeju Bank.

semrush.name: Semrush
semrush.description: Semrush Holdings, Inc. is an American software company and a wholly owned subsidiary of Adobe Inc. It provides a platform with tools for SEO, AI search visibility, competitor analysis, content marketing, paid advertising, and website auditing.

shinhan-financial-group.name: Shinhan Financial Group
shinhan-financial-group.description: Shinhan Financial Group Co., Ltd. is a financial holding company headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. Founded in 1982, it offers banking, securities, life insurance, and investment banking services and is one of Korea's Big Five financial groups.

sk-inc.name: SK Inc.
sk-inc.description: SK Inc. is the holding company of South Korea's SK Group, headquartered in Seoul. It operates through Investment and Business Divisions, covering industries such as petroleum, telecommunications, chemicals, semiconductors, and biotechnology. It holds major subsidiaries including SK Innovation and SK Telecom.

severn-trent.name: Severn Trent
severn-trent.description: Severn Trent plc is a water company based in Coventry, England. It supplies water to 4.6 million households and businesses across the Midlands, South West England, and Wales.

shaftesbury-capital.name: Shaftesbury Capital
shaftesbury-capital.description: Shaftesbury Capital, formerly Capital & Counties Properties plc, is a UK-based property investment and development company. It focuses on sites in London's West End, including Covent Garden, Chinatown, Carnaby Street, and Soho.

sonida-senior-living.name: Sonida Senior Living
sonida-senior-living.description: Sonida Senior Living, Inc. is a leading owner, operator, and investor in senior housing communities in the United States. Founded in 1990, it operates 96 senior housing communities across 20 states with a capacity of over 10,000 residents. The company owns 83 communities and manages 13 on behalf of third parties.

starz-entertainment.name: Starz Entertainment
starz-entertainment.description: Starz Entertainment Corp. is a Canadian-American entertainment company headquartered in Santa Monica, California. Founded in 1997 by Frank Giustra, it was formerly known as Lions Gate Entertainment Corporation and is incorporated in Vancouver, British Columbia.

shimadzu-corp.name: Shimadzu Corp.
shimadzu-corp.description: Shimadzu Corporation is a Japanese company based in Kyoto that manufactures precision and measuring instruments as well as medical equipment. Established in 1875, it also has an American subsidiary, Shimadzu Scientific Instruments, founded in 1975.

sumitomo-mitsui-trust-group.name: Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Group
sumitomo-mitsui-trust-group.description: Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Group, Inc. is a Japanese financial holding company headquartered in Chiyoda, Tokyo. It offers financial products focusing on asset management, financial brokerage, and real estate services to retail and wholesale customers.

sompo.name: SOMPO
sompo.description: SOMPO Holdings, Inc. is a Japanese insurance holding company formed in 2010 from the merger of Sompo Japan and Nipponkoa Insurance. It is one of the top three insurers in Japan and is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange as part of the Nikkei 225 index.

sca.name: SCA
sca.description: Svenska Cellulosa Aktiebolaget (SCA) is a Swedish manufacturer of timber, pulp, and paper products headquartered in Sundsvall. It is Europe's largest private owner of forest land, managing 2.7 million hectares. SCA's products include one-use paper items, containerboard, solid-wood products, pulp, and forest-based biofuel.

skf.name: SKF
skf.description: Aktiebolaget SKF is a Swedish company founded in 1907 in Gothenburg that manufactures and supplies bearings, seals, lubrication systems, and related products globally. It also provides maintenance products, mechatronics, power transmission products, and condition monitoring systems.

ssab.name: SSAB
ssab.description: SSAB AB is a Swedish steel-producing company formed in 1978. Its largest shareholders include the Swedish state-owned mining company LKAB and the Government of Finland. The company was formerly known as Svenskt Stål AB.

salem-media-group.name: Salem Media Group
salem-media-group.description: Salem Media Group, Inc. is an American media company based in Irving, Texas. It operates as a radio broadcaster, internet content provider, and publisher of magazines and books. The company targets audiences interested in Christian values and family-themed conservative content.

starwood.name: Starwood
starwood.description: Starwood Hotels and Resorts Worldwide, Inc. was a large company owning, operating, franchising, and managing hotels, resorts, spas, residences, and vacation ownership properties. Founded in 1969 as Hotel Investors Trust, it was acquired by Marriott International in 2016.

sitime.name: SiTime
sitime.description: SiTime Corporation is a fabless chipmaker based in Santa Clara, California. It develops micro-electromechanical systems (MEMS) used for timing devices in electronics. The company is publicly traded.

sensetime.name: SenseTime
sensetime.description: SenseTime is a partly state-owned artificial intelligence company headquartered in Hong Kong. It develops technologies such as facial recognition, image recognition, autonomous driving, and medical image analysis. Since 2019, it has faced repeated U.S. government sanctions related to its facial recognition technology.

satrec-initiative.name: Satrec Initiative
satrec-initiative.description: Satrec Initiative Co., Ltd. is a South Korean satellite manufacturing company headquartered in Daejeon. Founded in 1999 by engineers who developed Korea's first satellite, it designs Earth observation satellites and provides space components. It has subsidiaries focused on satellite imagery and radiation monitoring solutions.

shanda.name: Shanda
shanda.description: The Shanda Group is a privately owned multinational investment firm with offices in Shanghai, Singapore, Hong Kong, New York, and Redwood City. It invests in public markets, real estate, and venture capital, focusing on healthcare, financial services, media, and technology companies.

solarworld-industries.name: SolarWorld Industries
solarworld-industries.description: SolarWorld is a German company specializing in the manufacture and marketing of photovoltaic products worldwide. It integrates all components of the solar value chain, from polysilicon feedstock to module production and solar power system construction.

sbi-shinsei-bank.name: SBI Shinsei Bank
sbi-shinsei-bank.description: SBI Shinsei Bank, Limited is a Japanese bank headquartered in Chuo, Tokyo. It operates as a subsidiary of SBI Holdings and is listed on the Prime Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

sojitz.name: Sojitz
sojitz.description: Sojitz Corporation is a Tokyo-based sogo shosha (general trading company) engaged globally in buying, selling, importing, exporting, manufacturing, and providing services. It operates in diverse sectors including automobiles, energy, minerals, chemicals, foodstuff, agriculture, consumer goods, and industrial parks, and also conducts financing activities.

shiva-texyarn-limited.name: Shiva Texyarn Limited
shiva-texyarn-limited.description: Shiva Texyarn Limited is an Indian textile manufacturer based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. The company produces yarn, fabrics, garments, dry sheets, and home textiles within India.

sekerbank.name: Şekerbank
sekerbank.description: Şekerbank T.A.Ş. is a Turkish bank founded in 1953, originally named Sugar Beet Cooperative Bank. It provides consumer, vehicle, housing, and commercial loans. The bank is headquartered in Istanbul, Turkey, and Dr. Hasan Basri Göktan is its chairman.

sunrise-senior-living.name: Sunrise Senior Living
sunrise-senior-living.description: Sunrise Senior Living is an American operator of senior living communities. It operates more than 240 communities across the United States and Canada and is the seventh-largest senior living provider in the U.S. The company is based in the United States.

spire-inc.name: Spire Inc.
spire-inc.description: Spire Inc. is a regional public utility holding company headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri. It provides regulated natural gas services primarily through its subsidiary Laclede Gas Company, the largest natural gas distributor in Missouri. The company also engages in other profit-making businesses.

semiconductor-manufacturing-internationa.name: Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation
semiconductor-manufacturing-internationa.description: Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation (SMIC) is a Chinese semiconductor foundry company that is partially state-owned and publicly listed. It is the largest contract chip maker in mainland China.

securitas.name: Securitas
securitas.description: Securitas AB is a Swedish group specializing in security services including guarding, mobile patrolling, monitoring, investigation, and consulting. Headquartered in Stockholm, it operates in 44 markets worldwide and is listed on Nasdaq OMX Stockholm.

straumann.name: Straumann
straumann.description: Straumann Group is a Swiss company based in Basel that manufactures dental implants and related technologies. It researches, develops, manufactures, and supplies dental implants, instruments, biomaterials, CADCAM prosthetics, digital equipment, software, and clear aligners for dentistry applications.

sgs-s-a.name: SGS S.A.
sgs-s-a.description: SGS is a Swiss multinational company headquartered in Baar that provides inspection, verification, testing, and certification services. It operates a network of 2,600 offices and laboratories worldwide with nearly 100,000 employees. SGS has been ranked on the Forbes Global 2000 multiple times.

sulzer.name: Sulzer
sulzer.description: Sulzer Ltd. is a Swiss industrial engineering and manufacturing firm founded in 1775 and established as Sulzer Brothers Ltd. in 1834 in Winterthur, Switzerland. It operates about 180 manufacturing facilities and service centers globally. The company is publicly traded on the Swiss Stock Exchange.

sigma-aldrich.name: Sigma-Aldrich
sigma-aldrich.description: Sigma-Aldrich is a brand within an American chemical, life science, and biotechnology company owned by Merck Group. In the United States, Merck Group's life sciences business operates as MilliporeSigma.

supervalu.name: SuperValu
supervalu.description: SuperValu, Inc. was an American wholesaler and retailer of grocery products headquartered in Eden Prairie, Minnesota. Founded in 1926, it became a wholly owned subsidiary of United Natural Foods, Inc. (UNFI) in 2018.

samvardhana-motherson.name: Samvardhana Motherson
samvardhana-motherson.description: Samvardhana Motherson International Ltd is an Indian multinational automotive components manufacturer based in Noida, Uttar Pradesh. Established in 1986 as a joint venture with Japan's Sumitomo Group, it produces wiring harnesses, plastic components, and rearview mirrors for passenger cars.

sollers-jsc.name: Sollers JSC
sollers-jsc.description: Sollers PJSC is a Russian holding company controlling shares in Ulyanovsk Automobile Plant, Zavolzhye Engine Factory, and Sollers - Naberezhnye Chelny. It operates well-known automobile brands with stable market positions.

stanley-black-decker.name: Stanley Black & Decker
stanley-black-decker.description: Stanley Black & Decker, Inc. is an American manufacturer of industrial tools, household hardware, and security products. It is headquartered in New Britain, Connecticut. The company was formed by the merger of The Stanley Works and Black & Decker in 2010.

sculptor-capital-management.name: Sculptor Capital Management
sculptor-capital-management.description: Sculptor Capital Management is a global alternative asset management firm headquartered in New York City. It operates multiple investment strategies including multi-strategy, credit, and real estate, with offices in New York, London, and Hong Kong.

sumitomo-corporation.name: Sumitomo Corporation
sumitomo-corporation.description: Sumitomo Corporation is a large Japanese sōgō shōsha general trading company and diversified corporation. Incorporated in 1919, it is a member of the Sumitomo Group.

sjm-holdings-ltd.name: SJM HOLDINGS LTD.
sjm-holdings-ltd.description: Sociedade de Jogos de Macau, known as SJM Holdings Limited, is a Macau-based company that owns, operates, and develops casinos and integrated entertainment resorts in Macau. It is majority-owned by Sociedade de Turismo e Diversões de Macau (STDM) and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.

swvl.name: Swvl
swvl.description: Swvl Holdings Corp. is a Dubai-based transportation provider offering intercity, intracity, B2B, and B2G services. It operates in 135 cities across 20 countries in Latin America, Europe, Africa, and Asia.

sats-ltd.name: SATS Ltd
sats-ltd.description: SATS Ltd. is a Singaporean airport service company providing ground handling and in-flight catering at Changi Airport. It controls about 80% of the airport's ground handling and catering business.

sba-communications.name: SBA Communications
sba-communications.description: SBA Communications Corporation is a real estate investment trust owning and operating wireless infrastructure in the United States, Canada, Central America, South America, and South Africa. It was founded in 1989 by Steven Bernstein.

sbi-life-insurance-company-limited.name: SBI Life Insurance Company Limited
sbi-life-insurance-company-limited.description: SBI Life Insurance Company Limited is an Indian life insurance company started as a joint venture between State Bank of India and BNP Paribas Cardif.

scana.name: SCANA
scana.description: SCANA Corporation was an American regulated electric and natural gas public utility based in Cayce, South Carolina. It was acquired by Dominion Energy in January 2019 following the Nukegate scandal.

sei-investments-company.name: SEI Investments Company
sei-investments-company.description: SEI Investments Company is an American financial services company headquartered in Oaks, Pennsylvania. It provides financial technology, investment processing, operations, and asset management services to various financial clients.

slc-agricola.name: SLC Agrícola
slc-agricola.description: SLC Agrícola is one of the largest Brazilian agricultural producers, founded in 1977 by the SLC Group. It operates 16 farms across six Brazilian states and was the first company in its sector to have shares traded on a stock exchange. The company focuses on crops like cotton, soybean, and corn.

sl-green-realty.name: SL Green Realty
sl-green-realty.description: SL Green Realty Corp. is a real estate investment trust primarily investing in office buildings and shopping centers in New York City. It owns interests in 39 properties mainly in Manhattan and is known as New York City’s largest office landlord.

smtc-corporation.name: SMTC Corporation
smtc-corporation.description: SMTC Corporation is a mid-size electronics manufacturing services company founded in 1985. It operates facilities in the United States, Canada, Mexico, and China, providing end-to-end electronics manufacturing services.

soho-china.name: SOHO China
soho-china.description: SOHO China is a Chinese building developer focused on office and commercial properties, with some residential and mixed-use developments. Founded in 1995, the company combines office and residential spaces to create comfortable and productive environments.

ss-c-technologies.name: SS&C Technologies
ss-c-technologies.description: SS&C Technologies Holdings, Inc. is an American multinational holding company headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut. It sells software and software as a service to the financial services industry and has offices worldwide.

stv-group.name: STV Group
stv-group.description: STV Group plc is a media company based in Glasgow, Scotland. Starting as a television broadcaster in 1957, it expanded into newspapers, advertising, and radio, and now focuses on broadcast television, video-on-demand, and television production.

sunevision.name: SUNeVision
sunevision.description: SUNeVision is the technology arm of Sun Hung Kai Properties and the largest data centre provider in Hong Kong. The company offers carrier and cloud-neutral data centre services.

sea-group.name: SEA Group
sea-group.description: SEA Group, founded in 1956, is one of Hong Kong's longest-established property developers. It operates more than 200 projects worldwide, making it a diversified multinational real estate enterprise. Several of its subsidiaries are listed in the United Kingdom, Australia, and New Zealand.

sally-beauty-holdings.name: Sally Beauty Holdings
sally-beauty-holdings.description: Sally Beauty Holdings, Inc. is an American international specialty retailer and distributor of professional beauty supplies. The company operates in the consumer goods and retail sector.

samba-financial-group.name: Samba Financial Group
samba-financial-group.description: Samba Financial Group SJSC, formerly The Saudi American Bank, was a multinational banking firm based in Saudi Arabia. It operated 66 branches within the Kingdom.

sampath-bank.name: Sampath Bank
sampath-bank.description: Sampath Bank PLC is a licensed commercial bank incorporated in Sri Lanka in 1987. It operates 229 branches and 373 ATMs island-wide and has received awards such as the Bank of the Year by The Banker of Financial Times Limited.

sampo-corporation.name: Sampo Corporation
sampo-corporation.description: Sampo Corporation is a major Taiwanese manufacturer of household electrical items including televisions, air-conditioners, and washing machines. The company has collaborated with TCL and manufactures PDP-TVs for Thomson on a contract basis.

sampoerna.name: Sampoerna
sampoerna.description: PT Hanjaya Mandala Sampoerna Tbk, known as Sampoerna, is an Indonesian tobacco company owned by Philip Morris International. It is the largest tobacco company in Indonesia and produces clove cigarettes known locally as kretek cigarettes.

samsung-sds.name: Samsung SDS
samsung-sds.description: Samsung SDS Co., Ltd. is a South Korean IT services provider established in 1985 as a subsidiary of Samsung Group. It offers consulting, technical, and outsourcing services and is active in emerging IT technologies such as AI, Blockchain, and IoT. The company has headquarters in South Korea and eight overseas subsidiaries.

samyang-foods.name: Samyang Foods
samyang-foods.description: Samyang Roundsquare Co., Ltd. is a South Korean international food manufacturer and the first instant ramen company in South Korea. Founded in 1961 by Jeon Jung Yoon, it debuted the first Korean instant noodle in 1963.

sandridge-energy.name: SandRidge Energy
sandridge-energy.description: SandRidge Energy, Inc. is a company engaged in hydrocarbon exploration in the Mid-Continent region of the United States. It is organized in Delaware and headquartered in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma.

sangamo-therapeutics.name: Sangamo Therapeutics
sangamo-therapeutics.description: Sangamo Therapeutics, Inc. is an American biotechnology company based in Richmond, California. It develops cell and gene therapies for severe genetic diseases.

sanoyas-hishino-meisho.name: Sanoyas Hishino Meisho
sanoyas-hishino-meisho.description: Sanoyas Hishino Meisho Corporation is a Japanese company consisting of four principal business groups: Ship and Steel Structure, Parking System & Engineering, Construction Machines, and Leisure Business.

sansiri.name: Sansiri
sansiri.description: Sansiri is one of the largest real estate developers in Thailand. It was founded in 1984 by Srettha Thavisin, Apichat Chutrakul, and Wanchak Buranasiri.

sasken-communication-technologies.name: Sasken Communication Technologies
sasken-communication-technologies.description: Sasken Technologies is an Indian multinational company specializing in product engineering and embedded software. Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, it operates in the AI and software industry, providing technology solutions globally.

saudi-advanced-industries-company.name: Saudi Advanced Industries Company
saudi-advanced-industries-company.description: Saudi Advanced Industries Company is an industrial investment vehicle formed in 1987 under the U.S. Peace Shield defense offset program. It invests in technology companies in Saudi Arabia and holds interests in AlSalam Aircraft Company and the Aircraft Accessories & Components Company.

saudi-research-and-media-group.name: Saudi Research and Media Group
saudi-research-and-media-group.description: Saudi Research and Media Group (SRMG) is a Saudi state-backed media company registered in Riyadh. It mainly publishes, prints, and distributes various publications and operates within Saudi Arabia's media sector.

schneider-national.name: Schneider National
schneider-national.description: Schneider National, Inc. is an American transportation company providing truckload, intermodal, and logistics services. Its offerings include regional, long-haul, expedited, dedicated, bulk, brokerage, and supply chain management services.

schrodinger.name: Schrödinger
schrodinger.description: Schrödinger, Inc. is an international scientific software and biotechnology company specializing in computational tools and software for drug discovery and materials science. It operates globally with a focus on scientific innovation.

scottish-mortgage-investment-trust.name: Scottish Mortgage Investment Trust
scottish-mortgage-investment-trust.industry: Financial service activities, except insurance and pension funding
scottish-mortgage-investment-trust.description: Scottish Mortgage Investment Trust is a publicly traded investment trust based in Edinburgh, United Kingdom. It invests globally in businesses with above-average returns and is managed by Baillie Gifford & Co Limited. The trust is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index.

starhub.name: StarHub
starhub.description: StarHub Limited is a Singaporean multinational telecommunications conglomerate founded in 1998. It is one of the major telecommunications companies operating in Singapore and is listed on the Singapore Exchange (SGX).

sealed-air.name: Sealed Air
sealed-air.description: Sealed Air Corporation is an American packaging company headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina. It is known for its Cryovac food packaging and Bubble Wrap cushioning packaging products. The company is led by president and CEO Dustin Semach.

secureworks-inc.name: Secureworks Inc.
secureworks-inc.description: Secureworks Inc. was an American cybersecurity company serving approximately 4,000 customers in over 50 countries. Its clients ranged from Fortune 100 companies to mid-sized businesses across various industries.

sleep-number.name: Sleep Number
sleep-number.description: Sleep Number Corporation is an American manufacturer of adjustable beds, foundations, and bedding accessories. The company is based in Minneapolis, Minnesota, with manufacturing and distribution facilities in South Carolina and Utah.

sig-company.name: SIG (Company)
sig-company.description: PT Semen Indonesia (Persero) Tbk (SIG) is a state-owned holding company based in Indonesia providing building material solutions. It has 17 subsidiaries in Indonesia and Vietnam and operates mainly in the cement sector and related products across Asia, Australia, and Oceania.

seneca-foods.name: Seneca Foods
seneca-foods.description: Seneca Foods Corporation is an American food processor and distributor headquartered in Fairport, New York. It primarily operates in food packaging, selling canned vegetables, fruit products, and frozen items under various brands and private labels.

senomyx.name: Senomyx
senomyx.description: Senomyx is an American biotechnology company that develops food additives by reverse engineering human taste and aroma receptors. Founded in 1998 by Lubert Stryer and Paul Nevsky, it was acquired by the Swiss company Firmenich in September 2018.

sensient-technologies.name: Sensient Technologies
sensient-technologies.description: Sensient Technologies is a global manufacturer and marketer of colors, flavors, and fragrances based in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. Its products are used in foods, beverages, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, and other industries. In 2021, it was ranked 10th on the Global Top 50 Food Flavors and Fragrances Companies list.

sevcon.name: Sevcon
sevcon.description: Sevcon Inc. was a company that manufactured controls for electric vehicles. It was acquired by BorgWarner in September 2017. The company was based in the United Kingdom.

seven-bank.name: Seven Bank
seven-bank.description: Seven Bank, Ltd. is a Japanese bank affiliated with Seven-Eleven Japan, which is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Seven & I Holdings. It operates in the financial services sector in Japan.

seven-group-holdings.name: Seven Group Holdings
seven-group-holdings.description: SGH Limited, known as Seven Group Holdings, is an Australian diversified operating company with businesses across industrial services, energy, and media sectors.

seven-west-media.name: Seven West Media
seven-west-media.description: Seven West Media Limited is an Australian diversified media business with a presence in broadcast television, radio, print, and online publishing.

stora-enso.name: Stora Enso
stora-enso.description: Stora Enso Oyj is a Finnish and Swedish forest industry company that develops and produces various wood-based materials for multiple industries worldwide. It operates primarily in the pulp and paper industry and is known for its focus on sustainable wood products.

shandong-molong-petroleum-machinery.name: Shandong Molong Petroleum Machinery
shandong-molong-petroleum-machinery.description: Shandong Molong Petroleum Machinery Company Limited is a private petroleum machinery manufacturer based in Shouguang, Shandong, China. It produces oil well pumps, sucker rods, and other drilling machinery, serving major customers like Petrochina and Sinopec.

shanghai-industrial-holdings.name: Shanghai Industrial Holdings
shanghai-industrial-holdings.description: Shanghai Industrial Holdings Limited, incorporated in Hong Kong in 1996, is a conglomerate listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. It is part of several stock indices including the MSCI China All Shares Small Cap Index and participates in the Shanghai-Hong Kong and Shenzhen-Hong Kong Stock Connect programs.

shanxi-coking-co-ltd.name: Shanxi Coking Co., Ltd.
shanxi-coking-co-ltd.description: Shanxi Coking Co., Ltd. is a publicly traded coke manufacturing conglomerate in China. The company is listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange and operates within the coal industry.

sharecare.name: Sharecare
sharecare.description: Sharecare, Inc. is an American health and wellness company that provides personalized health information through its RealAge Test, a health risk assessment tool. It operates in the medical technology sector.

shenzhen-energy-group.name: Shenzhen Energy Group
shenzhen-energy-group.description: Shenzhen Energy Group Company Limited is a major power generation company based in Shenzhen, Guangdong, China. It develops various energy types and invests in new energy technologies, with Huaneng Power International as its second largest shareholder.

shenzhen-international-holdings.name: Shenzhen International Holdings
shenzhen-international-holdings.description: Shenzhen International Holdings Limited invests in, constructs, and operates logistics infrastructure and provides third-party logistics and information services. It is owned by Shenzhen Investment Holding Corporation and Cheung Kong Holdings.

shenzhen-investment.name: Shenzhen Investment
shenzhen-investment.description: Shenzhen Investment Limited is a property developer in Southern China partly owned by the Shenzhen Government. It also operates in infrastructure and cement sectors through other companies and has been listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange since 1997.

shenzhen-zhongjin-lingnan-nonfemet-compa.name: Shenzhen Zhongjin Lingnan Nonfemet Company
shenzhen-zhongjin-lingnan-nonfemet-compa.description: Zhongjin Lingnan Nonfemet Company Limited is a Chinese mining and metallurgy group headquartered in Shenzhen, Guangdong. It specializes in integrated mining, beneficiation, smelting, and trading of non-ferrous metals, mainly zinc and lead, with by-products including copper, silver, indium, and sulfuric acid.

sherritt-international.name: Sherritt International
sherritt-international.description: Sherritt International is a Canadian resource company based in Toronto, Ontario. It mines and refines nickel and cobalt and is the largest independent energy producer in Cuba.

shidax.name: Shidax
shidax.description: Shidax Corporation is a Japanese company providing food services and operating the largest karaoke shop chain in Japan.

shimizu-corporation.name: Shimizu Corporation
shimizu-corporation.description: Shimizu Corporation is a Japanese architectural, civil engineering, and general contracting firm. It is recognized as one of the top contractors in Japan and among the top 20 worldwide.

shoe-carnival.name: Shoe Carnival
shoe-carnival.description: Shoe Station Group, Inc., formerly Shoe Carnival Inc., is an American retailer of family footwear headquartered in Fort Mill, South Carolina. It operates 422 stores across 35 states and Puerto Rico under the Shoe Station and Shoe Carnival brands.

shoretel.name: ShoreTel
shoretel.description: ShoreTel, Inc. was a telecommunications vendor providing unified communications for business. The company was acquired by Mitel in 2017.

shanghai-international-port.name: Shanghai International Port
shanghai-international-port.description: Shanghai International Port (Group) Co., Ltd. is the exclusive operator of all public terminals in the Port of Shanghai. It is a majority state-owned company and part of several Chinese stock indices.

shoucheng-holdings.name: Shoucheng Holdings
shoucheng-holdings.description: Shoucheng Holdings Limited is a Hong Kong-based investment holding company and a subsidiary of the Beijing-based state-owned Shougang Group. The company focuses on infrastructure asset management and intelligent infrastructure investment across mainland China. It is classified as a red chip stock.

shutterfly.name: Shutterfly
shutterfly.description: Shutterfly, LLC is an American company headquartered in San Jose, California, specializing in photography products and image sharing. It is known for custom photo printing services including books, framed pictures, and other personalized items. The company operates several sub-brands such as TinyPrints, SnapFish, and Lifetouch.

sigma-designs.name: Sigma Designs
sigma-designs.description: Signet Jewelers Ltd., headquartered in Akron, Ohio and domiciled in Bermuda, is the world's largest retailer of diamond jewelry as of 2025. It operates in the middle-market jewelry segment and holds leading positions in the US, Canada, and UK specialty jewelry markets. The company owns brands including Blue Nile, Zales, Kay Jewelers, and Jared.

silicon-studio.name: Silicon Studio
silicon-studio.description: Silicon Studio Corporation is a Tokyo-based Japanese computer graphics technology company and HR services provider. It develops middleware software and real-time global illumination technology, and has developed video games for platforms including PlayStation 3, Nintendo 3DS, iOS, and Android. Notable products include YEBIS and Enlighten.

ssr-mining.name: SSR Mining
ssr-mining.description: SSR Mining Inc., formerly Silver Standard Resources, is a Denver-based producer of gold, silver, copper, lead, and zinc. It owns the largest silver mine in Argentina and engages in exploration across the Americas and Turkey. The company merged with Alacer Gold in 2020 and relocated its headquarters to Denver, Colorado.

shenergy-company.name: Shenergy Company
shenergy-company.description: Shenergy Group Company Limited is a state-owned enterprise owned by the Shanghai government in China. It is the parent company of Shenergy Company Limited, which is listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange. The company invests in electricity, petroleum, and natural gas in Shanghai and Eastern China.

sims-metal-management.name: Sims Metal Management
sims-metal-management.description: Sims Metal is a global environmental services conglomerate with operations in the US, Australia, and the UK. It focuses on metal recycling, data destruction, electronic goods recycling, municipal waste recycling, and energy from gas and waste. Founded in 1917, it operates through multiple divisions.

simulations-plus.name: Simulations Plus
simulations-plus.description: Simulations Plus, Inc. is a US-based software company that develops ADMET modeling and simulation software for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and other industries. In 2014, it acquired Cognigen Corporation, which provides clinical trial data analysis and consulting services.

sing-tao-news-corporation-limited.name: Sing Tao News Corporation Limited
sing-tao-news-corporation-limited.description: Sing Tao News Corporation Limited is a Hong Kong media company incorporated in Bermuda. It was formerly known as Global China Group Holdings Limited.

sino-ocean-group.name: Sino-Ocean Group
sino-ocean-group.description: Sino-Ocean Group Holding Limited is a Chinese investment holding company engaged in property investment and development. It develops mid to high-end residential properties and invests in urban complexes and office buildings.

sino-hotels.name: Sino Hotels
sino-hotels.description: Sino Hotels (Holdings) Limited is a hotel operator based in Hong Kong and incorporated in the Cayman Islands. It is affiliated with Sino Land Company Limited in Hong Kong and the Far East Organization in Singapore.

sinopharm-group.name: Sinopharm Group
sinopharm-group.description: Sinopharm Group Co., Ltd. is a Chinese pharmaceutical company. Its parent company is Sinopharm Industrial Investment, a joint venture between China National Pharmaceutical Group and Fosun Pharmaceutical.

sinotrans-shipping.name: Sinotrans Shipping
sinotrans-shipping.description: Sinotrans Shipping Ltd. is one of China's largest shipping companies, headquartered in Hong Kong and a subsidiary of China Merchants Group. It provides vessel chartering, freight forwarding, container line services, shipping agency, fleet management, and LNG shipping.

sirius-xm-canada.name: Sirius XM Canada
sirius-xm-canada.description: SiriusXM Canada Holdings Inc. is a Canadian broadcasting company that distributes American satellite radio provider SiriusXM's services in Canada.

skyworth.name: Skyworth
skyworth.description: Skyworth Group Co., Ltd. is a Chinese holding company headquartered in Shenzhen. Its subsidiaries design, manufacture, and sell televisions and other audio-visual products. The company also invests in properties and operates in locations including Hong Kong, Inner Mongolia, and Guangdong.

slater-and-gordon.name: Slater and Gordon
slater-and-gordon.description: Slater & Gordon Lawyers is an Australian law firm founded in Melbourne in 1935. It was established by Hugh Lyons Gordon and Bill Slater. Since April 2023, the firm has been owned by private equity firm Allegro Funds.

smith-micro-software.name: Smith Micro Software
smith-micro-software.description: Smith Micro Software, Inc. is a software developer and marketer headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. Founded in 1982, it offers enterprise and consumer-level software and services with offices in the United States, Europe, and Asia. The company focuses on digital lifestyle solutions and security technologies.

snyder-s-lance.name: Snyder's-Lance
snyder-s-lance.description: Snyder's-Lance, Inc. is the second largest salty snack maker in the United States. It was formed in 2010 by the merger of Lance Inc. and Snyder's of Hanover.

solarwinds.name: SolarWinds
solarwinds.description: SolarWinds Corporation is an American software company headquartered in Austin, Texas. It develops software to help businesses monitor and manage their networks, systems, and IT infrastructure. The company has sales and product development offices in the United States and other countries.

southwestern-energy.name: Southwestern Energy
southwestern-energy.description: Southwestern Energy Company was a natural gas exploration and production company headquartered in Spring, Texas, and organized in Delaware. In October 2024, it merged into Expand Energy, ceasing to exist as an independent entity.

spacelabs-healthcare.name: Spacelabs Healthcare
spacelabs-healthcare.description: Spacelabs Healthcare is an American medical equipment manufacturer headquartered in Snoqualmie, Washington. It is a wholly owned subsidiary of OSI Systems and offers products in patient monitoring, connectivity, and diagnostic cardiology. The company employs over one thousand people worldwide.

spartannash.name: SpartanNash
spartannash.description: SpartanNash Company is an American food distribution and retail company headquartered in Byron Center, Michigan. Founded in 1917, it adopted its current name in 2013 following a merger with Nash Finch Company.

spectra-energy.name: Spectra Energy
spectra-energy.description: Spectra Energy Corp was a Houston, Texas-based company operating in natural gas transmission, storage, distribution, and processing. Formed in 2006 from a Duke Energy spin-off, it owned the Texas Eastern Pipeline and operated three oil pipelines. In 2017, it merged into the Canadian company Enbridge.

spectrum-pharmaceuticals.name: Spectrum Pharmaceuticals
spectrum-pharmaceuticals.description: Spectrum Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is an American biopharmaceutical company located in Boston, Massachusetts. It develops and markets drugs for hematology and oncology treatments.

spin-master.name: Spin Master
spin-master.description: Spin Master Corp. is a Canadian multinational toy and entertainment company headquartered in Toronto, Ontario. It employs over 1,600 people globally and has offices in multiple countries including Australia, China, France, Germany, and the United States.

springs-global.name: Springs Global
springs-global.description: Springs Global is a Brazil-based multinational corporation that manufactures, markets, and sells packaged textile and non-textile home furnishings. It produces textile goods such as sheets, pillows, and towels under brands like Springmaid and Wamsutta. The company operates in several countries including Argentina, Mexico, Brazil, Canada, and the U.S.

sprouts-farmers-market.name: Sprouts Farmers Market
sprouts-farmers-market.description: Sprouts Farmers Market, Inc. is a supermarket chain headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona, specializing in natural and organic foods. It offers fresh produce, bulk foods, packaged groceries, and other items including vitamins and natural body care products. The company operates more than 400 stores across 24 states in the U.S.

sltmobitel.name: SLTMobitel
sltmobitel.description: Sri Lanka Telecom PLC, known as SLTMobitel, is the national telecommunications provider in Sri Lanka. It offers fixed and wireless telephony, Internet access, and IT services to domestic and business customers. As of 2024, it was the country's second largest mobile network operator with 7.1 million subscribers.

st-james-s-place-wealth-management-group.name: St. James's Place Wealth Management Group
st-james-s-place-wealth-management-group.legal_name: St. James's Place Wealth Management Group
st-james-s-place-wealth-management-group.description: St. James's Place plc is a British financial advice and wealth management company headquartered in Cirencester, Gloucestershire. It operates as an adviser, fund manager, and life insurance business with multiple offices across the UK. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is part of the FTSE 100 Index.

listings.name: St. James's Place Wealth Management Group

st-joe-company.name: St. Joe Company
st-joe-company.description: The St. Joe Company is a land development firm based in Panama City Beach, Florida. Founded in 1936, it focuses on real estate development and asset management, with land holdings mainly in Northwest Florida. The company develops land for residential, commercial, and medical uses and maintains a forestry division.

stamps-com.name: stamps.com
stamps-com.description: Stamps.com, now known as Auctane, is an American company providing Internet-based mailing and shipping services. Its main offices are in Austin, Texas. Previously a public company traded on NASDAQ, it was originally founded and based in Los Angeles before merging with Thoma Bravo.

stancorp-financial-group.name: StanCorp Financial Group
stancorp-financial-group.description: StanCorp Financial Group, Inc. is an insurance and financial services company headquartered in Portland, Oregon. Founded in 1906, its main subsidiary is Standard Insurance Company. The company was publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange from 1999 until 2016.

standard-chartered-bank-nepal.name: Standard Chartered Bank Nepal
standard-chartered-bank-nepal.description: Standard Chartered Nepal is a banking and financial services company operating in Nepal as a subsidiary of Standard Chartered PLC. It is currently the only international commercial bank operating in the country.

sp.name: SP+
sp.description: SP Plus Corporation is an American company providing parking facility management and related services such as baggage handling, ground transportation, and event logistics across the U.S. and Canada. It was formerly known as Standard Parking Corporation until December 2013.

sterling-bank.name: Sterling Bank
sterling-bank.description: Sterling Bank was a subsidiary of Sterling Bankshares, Inc. based in Houston, Texas. Founded in 1974 as Jersey Village Bank, it operated 56 banking centers across Texas metropolitan areas including Houston, San Antonio, Dallas, and Fort Worth. The bank served various regions including the Texas Hill Country.

stewart-information-services-corporation.name: Stewart Information Services Corporation
stewart-information-services-corporation.description: Stewart Information Services Corporation is a real estate information, title insurance, and transaction management company headquartered in Houston, Texas. It operates through wholly owned subsidiaries and a network of independent agencies in the United States and abroad. The company employs approximately 6,350 people.

stillwater-mining-company.name: Stillwater Mining Company
stillwater-mining-company.description: Stillwater Mining Company was a palladium and platinum mining company headquartered in Littleton, Colorado. It was the only producer of these metals in the USA and was acquired in 2017 by Sibanye Gold Limited, now trading as Sibanye-Stillwater. It exists today as a division of Sibanye-Stillwater.

sulamerica-seguros.name: SulAmérica Seguros
sulamerica-seguros.description: SulAmérica is the second largest Brazilian insurance company, founded in 1895 and controlled by Rede D'or. It serves over 7 million customers through a network of more than 30,000 independent brokers. The company offers various insurance lines including health, dental, automobile, life, as well as private pension, investments, and capitalization.

sunopta.name: SunOpta
sunopta.description: SunOpta, Inc. is a multinational food and mineral company headquartered in Eden Prairie, Minnesota. It was founded in Canada in 1973 and operates in both the food and mineral industries.

sunrun.name: Sunrun
sunrun.description: Sunrun Inc. is an American company providing photovoltaic systems and battery energy storage products. It is headquartered in San Francisco, California.

sun-communities.name: Sun Communities
sun-communities.description: Sun Communities, Inc. is a publicly traded real estate investment trust investing in manufactured housing and recreational vehicle communities. As of December 31, 2025, it owned interests in 513 properties across the United States, Canada, and the UK.

sun-hung-kai-co.name: Sun Hung Kai & Co.
sun-hung-kai-co.description: Sun Hung Kai & Co. Limited is a principal-led alternative investment platform based in Hong Kong. Established in 1969, it has roots in wealth management and invests across alternative asset classes including hedge funds, private equity, private credit, and real assets.

sun-national-bank.name: Sun National Bank
sun-national-bank.description: Sun National Bank was an American bank owned by holding company Sun Bancorp, Inc. It was headquartered in Mount Laurel, New Jersey, and served consumers and businesses through more than 30 branch locations in New Jersey and commercial lending offices in New Jersey, Pennsylvania, and New York.

sunday-communications-limited.name: Sunday Communications Limited
sunday-communications-limited.description: Sunday Communications Limited is a Cayman Islands incorporated holding company headquartered and listed in Hong Kong. It is the parent company of Mandarin Communications, a mobile network operator in Hong Kong.

sunland-group.name: Sunland Group
sunland-group.description: Sunland Group Limited is an Australian property development company headquartered in South East Queensland, Australia. Founded in 1983 by Iranian-Australian businessmen Soheil Abedian and Foad Fathi, it focuses on real estate development.

suominen-corporation.name: Suominen Corporation
suominen-corporation.description: Suominen Corporation is a Finnish company supplying nonwovens for consumer products worldwide. It is the global market leader in nonwovens for wipes and employs approximately 600 people across Finland, Italy, Spain, Brazil, and the United States.

support-com.name: Support.com
support-com.description: Support.com is a technical support service for businesses and consumers offered by RealDefense LLC. It was headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, with an administrative office in Sunnyvale, California, providing remote support for various operating systems and smart devices.

supreme-industries.name: Supreme Industries
supreme-industries.description: Supreme Industries Limited is an Indian plastics company based in Mumbai. It manufactures a variety of products including industrial molded furniture, storage crates, multi-layer films, PVC pipes, and disposable containers.

susquehanna-bank.name: Susquehanna Bank
susquehanna-bank.description: Susquehanna Bank was a Lancaster, Pennsylvania-based bank operating over 260 branches in four states. Its parent company was Susquehanna Bancshares, Inc., a regional financial services holding company based in Lititz, Pennsylvania.

swire-properties.name: Swire Properties
swire-properties.description: Swire Properties Limited is a property developer, owner, and operator of mixed-use commercial properties in Hong Kong and mainland China. Founded in 1972 and headquartered in Hong Kong, it is a subsidiary of Swire Pacific Limited.

synlait.name: Synlait
synlait.description: Synlait Milk Ltd. is a New Zealand dairy processor headquartered in Dunsandel, Canterbury. It sells dairy and plant-based nutritional products, ingredients, and powders globally. The company operates manufacturing sites in Auckland and Pōkeno and has offices in Beijing and Shanghai.

synnex.name: Synnex
synnex.description: Synnex was an American multinational corporation providing IT services to businesses. Founded in 1980 and based in Fremont, California, it served original equipment manufacturers, software publishers, and resellers. Synnex merged with Tech Data to form TD Synnex.

syria-international-islamic-bank.name: Syria International Islamic Bank
syria-international-islamic-bank.description: Syria International Islamic Bank (SIIB) is a Syrian bank established in 2007 and headquartered in Damascus. It is a public company with capital held by Qatari and Syrian shareholders and has been listed on the Damascus Securities Exchange since 2009.

sysmex-corporation.name: Sysmex Corporation
sysmex-corporation.description: Sysmex Corporation is a Japanese healthcare company headquartered in Kobe. Originally called TOA Medical Electronics, it was established under the Sysmex brand in 1978 focusing on haematology analysers. The company was renamed Sysmex Corporation in 1998.

spectrum-brands.name: Spectrum Brands
spectrum-brands.description: Spectrum Brands Holdings, Inc. is an American multinational consumer products conglomerate headquartered in Middleton, Wisconsin. It was established in 2005 as the successor to Rayovac Corporation.

samsara.name: Samsara
samsara.description: Samsara Inc. is an American IoT company headquartered in San Francisco, California. It provides telematics software and insights for physical operations across North America and Europe. Samsara developed a connected operations cloud platform supporting industries like transportation, construction, energy, utilities, public sector, and retail.

sophia-genetics.name: Sophia Genetics
sophia-genetics.description: Sophia Genetics SA is a Swiss-founded data-driven medicine software company with headquarters in Rolle, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts. It also has offices in France and provides genomic, radiomic, and multimodal analysis for hospitals, laboratories, and biopharma institutions.

steris.name: Steris
steris.description: Steris plc is a medical equipment company specializing in sterilization, sterile processing, and surgical products for the US healthcare system. It is operationally headquartered in Mentor, Ohio, and legally registered in Dublin, Ireland for tax purposes since 2018. The company was previously registered in the UK from 2014 to 2018.

shanghai-petrochemical.name: Shanghai Petrochemical
shanghai-petrochemical.description: Shanghai Petrochemical, a subsidiary of Sinopec, is one of the largest petrochemical enterprises in Mainland China. It produces ethylene, fiber, resin, and plastics and is registered in Shanghai.

shanghai-oriental-pearl-media.name: Shanghai Oriental Pearl Media
shanghai-oriental-pearl-media.description: Shanghai Oriental Pearl Media is a cultural company engaged in touring, radio and TV transmission, media investments, advertising, video game console manufacturing, software development, and real estate investments. It is recognized as one of the 50 pivotal large-scale enterprises by the Shanghai government.

smc-corporation.name: SMC Corporation
smc-corporation.description: SMC Corporation is a Japanese company specializing in pneumatic control engineering for industrial automation. Founded in 1959 and headquartered in Tokyo, it has a global engineering network and production facilities across multiple continents.

sinofert-holdings.name: Sinofert Holdings
sinofert-holdings.description: Sinofert Holdings Limited is the largest all-rounded fertilizer enterprise in China. It engages in chemical fertilizer research and development, production, procurement, and distribution within China.

shenzhen-bao-an-international-airport.name: Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport
shenzhen-bao-an-international-airport.description: Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport serves Shenzhen city in Guangdong, China. It is a hub for several airlines and underwent major expansions in the 2010s, including new runways and terminals.

sky-perfect-jsat-corporation.name: SKY Perfect JSAT Corporation
sky-perfect-jsat-corporation.description: SKY Perfect JSAT Corporation is a Japanese entertainment and broadcasting company based in Minato, Tokyo. Founded in 1994, it owns the DBS service SKY PerfecTV! and other businesses in the broadcasting sector.

sezzle.name: Sezzle
sezzle.description: Sezzle is a financial technology company headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota, operating in the United States and Canada. It provides an alternative payment platform offering interest-free installment plans at selected online stores.

smartsheet-inc.name: Smartsheet Inc.
smartsheet-inc.description: Smartsheet Inc. develops and markets Smartsheet, a software as a service (SaaS) platform for collaboration and work management. The software helps users assign tasks, track project progress, manage calendars, share documents, and manage other work using a tabular interface.

skycity-entertainment-group.name: Skycity Entertainment Group
skycity-entertainment-group.description: SkyCity Entertainment Group is a gambling and entertainment company based in Auckland, New Zealand. It owns and operates five casino properties in New Zealand and Australia, including restaurants, bars, hotels, a convention centre, and Auckland's Sky Tower.

scor-se.name: SCOR SE
scor-se.description: SCOR SE is a French tier 1 reinsurance company providing Property and Casualty and Life reinsurance. Founded in 1970 with support from the French government, it was originally named Société Commerciale de Réassurance. In 2007, it became the first French listed company to use the SE acronym in its name.

seoul-broadcasting-system.name: Seoul Broadcasting System
seoul-broadcasting-system.description: Seoul Broadcasting System is a leading South Korean television and radio broadcaster. It legally adopted the name SBS in March 2000, and its flagship terrestrial television station broadcasts as channel 6 for digital and cable.

sea-ltd.name: Sea Ltd
sea-ltd.description: Sea Limited is a tech conglomerate headquartered in Singapore. It serves as a holding company for Garena, Monee, and Shopee, the largest e-commerce platform in Southeast Asia. It is listed on the New York Stock Exchange.

sina-corporation.name: Sina Corporation
sina-corporation.description: Sina Corporation is a Chinese internet and online media company known for operating the Sina.com portal and controlling Weibo Corporation. It was formed in 1999 and is headquartered in Beijing, incorporated in the Cayman Islands.

spicejet.name: SpiceJet
spicejet.description: SpiceJet is an Indian low-cost airline headquartered in Gurgaon, Haryana. It is the fourth largest airline in India by domestic passengers carried as of May 2025.

sohu.name: Sohu
sohu.description: Sohu, Inc. is a Chinese Internet company headquartered in the Sohu Internet Plaza in Haidian District, Beijing. It offers services including advertising, a search engine (Sogou.com), and online multiplayer gaming (ChangYou.com).

sears-holdings-corporation.name: Sears Holdings Corporation
sears-holdings-corporation.description: Sears Holdings Corporation was an American holding company headquartered in Hoffman Estates, Illinois. It was the parent company of Kmart and Sears stores, founded after Kmart purchased Sears in 2005. The company filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in 2018 and sold its assets to ESL Investments in 2019.

skandinaviska-enskilda-banken.name: Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken
skandinaviska-enskilda-banken.description: Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken AB (SEB) is a Swedish bank headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. It provides financial services primarily in Sweden.

sunnova.name: Sunnova
sunnova.description: Sunnova Energy International Inc. was an American energy company headquartered in Houston, Texas. Founded in 2012, it provided residential solar panel installations, battery storage, and repair services primarily in the United States.

sanepar.name: Sanepar
sanepar.description: Sanepar is a Brazilian water supply and sewage company owned by the state of Paraná. It provides water and sanitation services to millions of customers across hundreds of cities and areas in Paraná and Santa Catarina states, including waste management and landfill operations.

shanghai-electric.name: Shanghai Electric
shanghai-electric.description: Shanghai Electric is a Chinese multinational power generation and electrical equipment manufacturing company headquartered in Shanghai. The company traces its roots back to 1880.

sinotruk-hong-kong-limited.name: Sinotruk (Hong Kong) Limited
sinotruk-hong-kong-limited.description: Sinotruk Limited is a Hong Kong truck manufacturer incorporated in 2007. Its subsidiaries manufacture trucks in Mainland China. The parent company is China National Heavy Duty Truck Group, a Chinese state-owned heavy truck manufacturer headquartered in Jinan, Shandong Province.

surveymonkey.name: SurveyMonkey
surveymonkey.description: SurveyMonkey Inc. is an American software-as-a-service company providing online survey and forms tools. Founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Mateo, California, its platform is used globally across various sectors including business, education, and healthcare.

sonatrach.name: Sonatrach
sonatrach.description: Sonatrach is Algeria's national state-owned oil company, founded in 1963. It is the largest company in Africa with 154 subsidiaries and is recognized as the first African oil major. In 2021, it ranked as the seventh largest gas company worldwide.

surgutneftegas.name: Surgutneftegas
surgutneftegas.description: Surgutneftegas is a Russian oil and gas company headquartered in Surgut, Khanty-Mansi Autonomous Okrug. It was created by merging several state-owned companies with large oil and gas reserves in Western Siberia. In 2020, it was ranked as the 251st-largest public company globally by Forbes.

sacyr.name: Sacyr
sacyr.description: SACYR S.A. is a Spanish infrastructure operator and developer company based in Madrid. It operates in the construction and infrastructure sector in Spain.

sonangol-group.name: Sonangol Group
sonangol-group.description: Group Sonangol is a parastatal that oversaw petroleum and natural gas production in Angola. It consisted of Sonangol E.P. and its subsidiaries, serving various clients. In 2023, Sonangol produced 202,000 barrels of oil.

societe-nationale-d-electricite.name: Société nationale d'électricité
societe-nationale-d-electricite.hq: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
societe-nationale-d-electricite.description: Société Nationale d'Électricité (SNEL) is the national electricity company of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, headquartered in Kinshasa. It operates the Inga Dam on the Congo River and thermal power stations. SNEL is responsible for electric power generation in the country.

sterling-bank-nigeria.name: Sterling Bank
sterling-bank-nigeria.description: Sterling Bank Ltd. is a Nigerian commercial bank licensed by the Central Bank of Nigeria. It is headquartered at Sterling Towers, 20 Marina, Lagos, and is a wholly owned subsidiary of Sterling Financial Holdings Company Plc. The bank has sister subsidiaries including The Alternative Bank Limited and SterlingFI Wealth Management Limited.

sparebank-1-smn.name: SpareBank 1 SMN
sparebank-1-smn.description: SpareBank 1 SMN is a Norwegian savings bank based in Trøndelag. It operates in the financial services industry.

sinnerschrader.name: SinnerSchrader
sinnerschrader.description: SinnerSchrader was a digital agency headquartered in Hamburg, Germany, founded in 1996. It was publicly listed from 1999 and became part of Accenture in 2017, fully integrating into Accenture Song by 2022. The company operated in the internet economy sector.

sparebanken-sr.name: Sparebanken Sør
sparebanken-sr.description: Sparebanken Sør was a Norwegian banking and financial services group based in Kristiansand, Norway. Its main market was in the counties of Agder, Telemark, and Rogaland. The company operated in the financial services sector.

sparebanken-mre.name: Sparebanken Møre
sparebanken-mre.description: Sparebanken Møre is a Norwegian savings bank headquartered in Ålesund, Norway. It serves the Møre og Romsdal region and was formed by merging several savings banks in that area. The bank operates in the financial services sector.

sparebank-1-buskerud-vestfold.name: SpareBank 1 Buskerud-Vestfold
sparebank-1-buskerud-vestfold.description: SpareBank 1 BV was a Norwegian savings bank headquartered in Sandefjord, Norway. Its main market was Buskerud and Vestfold, with history tracing back to 1883.

sparebank-1-ringerike-hadeland.name: SpareBank 1 Ringerike Hadeland
sparebank-1-ringerike-hadeland.description: SpareBank 1 Ringerike Hadeland is a Norwegian savings bank headquartered in Hønefoss. Its main market includes Ringerike in Buskerud and the Hadeland district of Oppland. The bank traces its history back to 1833 with the establishment of Ringerikes Sparebank.

sparebanken-st.name: Sparebanken Øst
sparebanken-st.description: Sparebanken Øst is a Norwegian savings bank headquartered in Drammen, Norway. Its main market is the eastern part of Norway, and it was established in 1843. The bank operates within the financial services industry.

sierra-leone-red-cross-society.name: Sierra Leone Red Cross Society
sierra-leone-red-cross-society.description: Sierra Leone Red Cross Society (SLRCS) is a national humanitarian organization established in 1962 by an act of the Parliament of Sierra Leone. It is headquartered in Freetown and focuses on emergency and relief efforts.

stoxx-europe-600-index.name: Stoxx Europe 600 Index
stoxx-europe-600-index.description: The STOXX Europe 600 is a stock index designed by STOXX Ltd representing 600 European companies across 17 countries. It covers approximately 90% of the free-float market capitalization of the European stock market.

smiles-s-a.name: Smiles S.A.
smiles-s-a.description: Smiles S.A. is a Brazilian company managing the Smiles loyalty program, formerly the frequent-flyer program of Varig. The program is now associated with GOL Linhas Aéreas Inteligentes S.A.

sefalana.name: Sefalana
sefalana.description: Sefalana is Botswana's second largest food retailer operating more than 1200 stores across Africa. The company is headquartered in Gaborone, Botswana, and is publicly listed on the Botswana Stock Exchange.

seres-group.name: Seres Group
seres-group.description: Seres Group is a Chinese automotive manufacturer headquartered in Chongqing, China, founded in 1986. It produces electric and internal combustion engine cars, motorcycles, commercial vehicles, and shock absorbers through its subsidiaries.

sina-bank.name: Sina Bank
