sina-bank.description: Sina Bank is a private Iranian bank offering retail, commercial, and investment banking services. It was established in 1985 as part of the government's privatization of the banking system. The bank operates within Iran's financial services sector.

silvergate-capital.name: Silvergate Capital
silvergate-capital.description: Silvergate Bank was a California-based bank founded in 1988. It began providing services for cryptocurrency users in 2016 and conducted an IPO in 2019.

saipa.name: Saipa
saipa.description: SAIPA is an Iranian automaker headquartered in Tehran. Established in 1965 to assemble Citroëns under license, it changed its name in 1975 and now produces mostly under-licensed Korean cars and its own engines.

symetra.name: Symetra
symetra.description: Symetra is an American family of companies providing retirement plans, employee benefits, annuities, and life insurance through independent distributors nationwide. The company is headquartered in Bellevue, Washington.

saputo.name: Saputo
saputo.description: Saputo Inc. is a Canadian dairy company headquartered in Montreal, Quebec. Founded in 1954 by the Saputo family, it produces, markets, and distributes a wide range of dairy products including cheese, fluid milk, and cultured products. It is one of the top ten dairy processors globally.

spizzico.name: Spizzico
spizzico.description: Spizzico is a chain of franchised quick-service pizzerias owned by the Italian multinational catering company Autogrill.

sdl.name: SDL
sdl.description: SDL plc was a British multinational professional services company based in Maidenhead, UK. It specialized in language translation software and services and was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition by RWS Group in 2020.

smithfield-foods.name: Smithfield Foods
smithfield-foods.description: Smithfield Foods, Inc. is an American pork producer and food-processing company based in Smithfield, Virginia. Founded in 1936, it is the largest pig and pork producer globally and is majority owned by Hong Kong-based WH Group. The company operates farms and processing facilities in multiple countries.

samsung-securities.name: Samsung Securities
samsung-securities.description: Samsung Securities Co., Ltd. is a South Korean financial services company headquartered in Seoul. It is a subsidiary of Samsung Group and ranks among the largest securities companies in Korea.

superdry.name: Superdry
superdry.description: Superdry Limited is a British clothing company owning the Superdry & Co label. Its products combine vintage American styling with Japanese-inspired graphics. Despite the Japanese lettering, Superdry has never expanded into Japan.

seacor-holdings.name: SEACOR Holdings
seacor-holdings.description: SEACOR Holdings is an American company headquartered in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. It provides equipment and services to the offshore petroleum and marine transportation industries. The company also holds a 70% ownership stake in a bioethanol plant located in Illinois.

southern-california-edison.name: Southern California Edison
southern-california-edison.industry: Electric power generation, transmission and distribution
southern-california-edison.description: Southern California Edison is the primary electric utility company serving much of Southern California, United States. It provides electricity to 15 million people across a large service territory.

silicon-valley-bank.name: Silicon Valley Bank
silicon-valley-bank.description: Silicon Valley Bank was an independent commercial bank now operating as a division of First Citizens BancShares. It was the primary subsidiary of SVB Financial Group with offices in 15 U.S. states and multiple international locations. The SVB name will be phased out by Q4 2026.

scs.name: ScS
scs.description: poltronesofà UK, formerly known as ScS, is a home furnishings retailer in the United Kingdom specializing in sofas. It has been owned by the Italian furniture group Poltronesofà since 2024, and its UK stores were rebranded from ScS to poltronesofà in March 2026.

sepahan-oil-company-soc.name: Sepahan Oil Company (SOC)
sepahan-oil-company-soc.description: Sepahan Oil Company (SOC) is an independent oil refining company based in Tehran, Iran, with refining facilities in Isfahan. Established in 2002, it is the largest producer of base oil in the Middle East and produces diesel and engine oils under the Speedy brand.

state-printing-company.name: State Printing Company
state-printing-company.description: ANY Security Printing Company, formerly known as State Printing Company, is a major security printing firm based in Hungary and the CEE region. It focuses on security documents, plastic card production, electronic document management, and bulk transactional printing. The company has been listed on the Budapest Stock Exchange since 2005.

sears-canada.name: Sears Canada
sears-canada.description: Sears Canada Inc. was a publicly traded Canadian retail company headquartered in Toronto. It operated from 1952 to 2018 and was affiliated with the American Sears chain, owning 125 full-line department stores at its peak.

stratec-biomedical-systems.name: Stratec Biomedical Systems
stratec-biomedical-systems.description: STRATEC SE is a German company that designs and manufactures fully automated analyzer systems for clinical diagnostics and biotechnology partners. It specializes particularly in the field of in-vitro diagnostics and operates worldwide.

suntory-global-spirits.name: Suntory Global Spirits
suntory-global-spirits.description: Suntory Global Spirits Inc. is an American beverage company and a subsidiary of Suntory Holdings, a Japanese multinational beverage conglomerate. The company produces alcoholic beverages and was formerly known as Beam Suntory, Inc. and Beam, Inc.

s-p-bvl-peru-general-index.name: S&P/BVL Peru General Index
s-p-bvl-peru-general-index.description: The S&P/BVL Peru General Index is the main index of the Lima Stock Exchange. It serves as a broad benchmark for the Peruvian stock market by tracking the largest and most frequently traded stocks on the exchange.

s-immo.name: S IMMO
s-immo.description: S IMMO AG is a real estate investment company investing in properties across Austria, Germany, and Central and Eastern Europe. As of the end of 2023, it held property assets totaling just under EUR 3.5 billion.

sify.name: Sify
sify.description: Sify Technologies Limited is an Indian ICT company providing telecom, data center, cloud, managed, transformation integration, and application integration services. It was an early provider of Internet and e-commerce services in India and has been listed on NASDAQ since October 1999.

saman-bank.name: Saman Bank
saman-bank.description: Saman Bank is a privately owned Iranian bank that is listed on the Tehran Stock Exchange.

serco-group.name: Serco Group
serco-group.description: Serco Group plc is a British multinational company headquartered in Hook, Hampshire, England. It provides services in defence, health, space, justice, migration, customer services, and transport across Europe, the Middle East, Asia Pacific, and North America.

s-p-tsx-60.name: S&P/TSX 60
s-p-tsx-60.description: The S&P/TSX 60 Index is a Canadian stock market index comprising 60 large companies listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange. Launched in 1998 by the Canadian S&P Index Committee, it covers nine sectors of the Canadian economy. It is part of the broader S&P/TSX Composite Index and the S&P Global 1200.

sap-concur.name: SAP Concur
sap-concur.description: SAP Concur is an American software as a service company headquartered in Bellevue, Washington. It provides travel and expense management services to businesses and was acquired by SAP SE in 2014.

shahr-bank.name: Shahr Bank
shahr-bank.description: Shahr Bank is a private Iranian bank that began operations in February 2009. Previously, it provided financial services under the names Honarvaran Shahr Cooperative and Shahr Credit Cooperative.

samchundang-pharm.name: SamChunDang Pharm
samchundang-pharm.description: Sam Chun Dang Pharm Co., Ltd. (SCD) is a South Korean pharmaceutical company engaged in developing, manufacturing, and selling prescription medicines. Founded in 1943, it is headquartered in Seocho-gu, Seoul, with manufacturing in Hwaseong, Gyeonggi Province. The company is listed on the Korea Exchange.

samsung-life-insurance.name: Samsung Life Insurance
samsung-life-insurance.description: Samsung Life Insurance is a South Korean multinational insurance company headquartered in Seoul. It is a subsidiary of Samsung Group and is the largest insurance company in South Korea, also listed among the Fortune Global 500.

skyeurope-airlines.name: SkyEurope Airlines
skyeurope-airlines.description: SkyEurope Airlines was a low-cost airline headquartered in Bratislava, Slovakia, with bases in Bratislava and Prague. It operated short-haul scheduled and charter passenger services before filing for bankruptcy and suspending all flights in 2009.

swiss-market-index.name: Swiss Market Index
swiss-market-index.description: The Swiss Market Index (SMI) is Switzerland's blue-chip stock market index composed of 20 of the largest and most liquid Swiss Performance Index stocks. It is the most followed stock market index in Switzerland and is a price index not adjusted for dividends.

stingray-radio.name: Stingray Radio
stingray-radio.description: Stingray Radio Inc. is a Canadian radio broadcasting conglomerate owned by Stingray Group. It operates 101 radio stations across Canada, primarily in Atlantic and Western regions, with significant presence in Alberta and Newfoundland. It once owned two now-defunct television stations in Lloydminster.

sig-plc.name: SIG plc
sig-plc.description: SIG plc is a British-based international supplier of insulation, roofing, commercial interiors, and specialist construction products. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange. It operates primarily in the construction sector.

sedmoi-kontinent.name: Sedmoi Kontinent
sedmoi-kontinent.description: Sedmoi Kontinent is a major grocery retail chain headquartered in Moscow, Russia. It operates 140 stores in Russia and one in Belarus. The company is focused on retail grocery operations.

saipa-diesel.name: Saipa Diesel
saipa-diesel.description: SAIPA Diesel Company, originally branded Iran Kaveh, is an Iranian manufacturer of trucks and trailers. The company operates in the automotive industry and is based in Iran.

sandvine.name: Sandvine
sandvine.description: AppLogic Networks Corporation, formerly Sandvine Incorporated, is a Canadian application and network intelligence company based in Waterloo, Ontario.

sarmayeh-bank.name: Sarmayeh Bank
sarmayeh-bank.description: Sarmayeh Bank is an Iranian bank founded in 2005 as part of the government's privatization of the banking system. It operates within Iran's financial services sector and was established to support the privatization efforts in the banking industry.

scottish-american-investment-company.name: Scottish American Investment Company
scottish-american-investment-company.industry: Financial service activities, except insurance and pension funding
scottish-american-investment-company.description: The Scottish American Investment Company is a publicly traded investment trust investing in a broad range of UK and international assets. Managed by Baillie Gifford & Co Limited in Edinburgh, it is listed on the London Stock Exchange and part of the FTSE 250 Index.

senior-plc.name: Senior plc
senior-plc.description: Senior plc is a holding company for a global group of manufacturing and engineering firms headquartered in Rickmansworth, England. It was listed on the London Stock Exchange and was part of the FTSE 250 Index until its acquisition by Tinicum Inc. and Blackstone Private Investments Advisors in October 2026.

shaftesbury-plc.name: Shaftesbury plc
shaftesbury-plc.description: Shaftesbury PLC was a British real estate investment trust focused exclusively on London's West End. Headquartered in London, it was listed on the London Stock Exchange until merging with Capital & Counties Properties to form Shaftesbury Capital in March 2023.

spectris.name: Spectris
spectris.description: Spectris plc is a supplier of precision instrumentation and controls based in the United Kingdom. It was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition by KKR in December 2025.

st-modwen-properties.name: St. Modwen Properties
st-modwen-properties.description: St. Modwen Properties Ltd. was a British property investment and development company specializing in regenerating brownfield land and urban environments. Headquartered in Birmingham, it operated regional offices across the UK. The company was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition by The Blackstone Group in August 2021.

sun-rype.name: Sun-Rype
sun-rype.description: Sun-Rype Products Ltd. is a Western Canadian manufacturer of fruit-based food and beverages. Founded in 1946, the company produces juices and fruit snacks and is based in Kelowna, British Columbia, in the Okanagan region.

synergy-health.name: Synergy Health
synergy-health.description: Synergy Health plc was a UK-based global company providing specialist outsourced services to healthcare markets worldwide. Its services included sterilization for medical device manufacturers and decontamination of surgical instruments. The company was listed on the London Stock Exchange until its acquisition by Steris Corporation in 2014.

synthomer.name: Synthomer
synthomer.description: Synthomer plc is a British-based chemicals business formerly known as Yule Catto & Co. The company is listed on the London Stock Exchange.

s-p-bse-sensex.name: S&P BSE Sensex
s-p-bse-sensex.description: The BSE SENSEX is an Indian stock market index of 30 well-established and financially sound companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange. It represents various industrial sectors of the Indian economy and has been published since January 1, 1986. It is regarded as the pulse of domestic stock markets in India.

savencia-fromage-dairy.name: Savencia Fromage & Dairy
savencia-fromage-dairy.description: Savencia Fromage & Dairy is a French food company specializing in cheese production. It is an independent family group owned by the Bongrain family and includes brands such as Saint Agur Blue and Saint Albray. The company was formerly named Bongrain until 2015.

sanok-rubber-company.name: Sanok Rubber Company
sanok-rubber-company.description: Sanok Rubber Company S.A. is a Polish company specializing in the production of rubber products. It is based in Sanok, Poland.

suez-company.name: Suez Company
suez-company.description: The Suez Company, also known as the Suez Canal Company, was formed in 1858 to operate the concession for the Suez Canal, which it built between 1859 and 1869. Initially owned by French investors and Egypt's ruler, it operated the canal until 1956 when Egypt revoked its concession and transferred operation to the state.

sky-gabon.name: Sky Gabon
sky-gabon.description: Sky Gabon was a cargo airline based in Libreville, Gabon, with its main base at Libreville International Airport. It was on the list of air carriers banned in the European Union and ceased all operations in 2019.

sonatel.name: Sonatel
sonatel.description: Sonatel is the principal telecommunications provider of Senegal, created in 1985. It offers fixed line and mobile telephony, internet service, television, and corporate telecommunications, and manages 2,200 kilometers of fiber optic cable in Senegal.

societe-nationale-des-hydrocarbures.name: Société Nationale des Hydrocarbures
societe-nationale-des-hydrocarbures.description: Société Nationale des Hydrocarbures (SNH) is Cameroon's national oil and gas company, established on 12 March 1980. It partners with international oil companies and manages the sale of the government's share of oil output. SNH also holds minor stakes in projects operated by international partners.

sirte-oil-company.name: Sirte Oil Company
sirte-oil-company.description: Sirte Oil Company (SOC) is a Libyan oil and gas company operating under the state-owned National Oil Corporation. Located in Brega, SOC's operations include oil and gas exploration, production, and manufacturing.

saham-bank.name: Saham Bank
saham-bank.description: Saham Bank is a Moroccan commercial bank headquartered in Casablanca. It was originally established in 1913 as the Moroccan subsidiary of the French banking group Société Générale.

societe-nationale-de-radiodiffusion-et-d.name: Société Nationale de Radiodiffusion et de Télévision
societe-nationale-de-radiodiffusion-et-d.legal_name: Société Nationale de Radiodiffusion et de Télévision
societe-nationale-de-radiodiffusion-et-d.description: The National Company of Radio and Television is Morocco's public state-owned broadcaster. It operates as the country's official mass media organization.

somaca.name: Somaca
somaca.description: Somaca is a Moroccan car manufacturer founded in 1959 by Fiat company Simca. It is currently owned by the French company Renault.

sonasid.name: Sonasid
sonasid.description: Sonasid is a Moroccan steel manufacturing company headquartered in Casablanca. It produces steel products mainly used in construction, such as rebar and wire rod. The company operates industrial plants in Nador and Jorf Lasfar.

societe-nigerienne-du-petrole.name: Société nigérienne du pétrole
societe-nigerienne-du-petrole.description: Société nigérienne du pétrole (SONIDEP) is a parastatal corporation in Niger founded in 1977 by government decree. It handles the importation, transportation, storage, refining, and marketing of petroleum products and operates retail sales stations nationwide.

silverbird-group.name: Silverbird Group
silverbird-group.description: The Silverbird Group is a diversified multimedia company headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria. Founded in 1980 by Ben Murray-Bruce, it has holdings in radio, television, real estate, and cinemas. The group includes Silverbird Cinemas and organizes pageants such as Most Beautiful Girl in Nigeria and Mr Nigeria.

saipem-nigeria.name: Saipem Nigeria
saipem-nigeria.description: Saipem Nigeria is the Nigerian subsidiary of Saipem, providing services to the oil and gas industry including drilling, construction, engineering, and maintenance both onshore and offshore. It operates within Nigeria's energy sector.

shell-nigeria.name: Shell Nigeria
shell-nigeria.description: Shell Nigeria refers to Shell plc's operations in Nigeria, conducted through four subsidiaries including Shell Petroleum Development Company of Nigeria Limited. Royal Dutch Shell's joint ventures produce over 21% of Nigeria's total petroleum output. The company operates in the petroleum industry.

south-atlantic-petroleum.name: South Atlantic Petroleum
south-atlantic-petroleum.description: South Atlantic Petroleum, also known as SAPETRO, is a Nigerian oil and gas exploration and production company. It holds a stake in the Akpo deepwater field development near Port Harcourt. The company's chairman is Theophilus Danjuma.

suntrust-bank-nigeria-limited.name: SunTrust Bank Nigeria Limited
suntrust-bank-nigeria-limited.description: SunTrust Bank Nigeria Limited (STBNL) is a Nigerian financial services provider licensed as a commercial bank by the Central Bank of Nigeria. It operates within Nigeria's banking sector.

stanbic-bank-uganda-limited.name: Stanbic Bank Uganda Limited
stanbic-bank-uganda-limited.description: Stanbic Bank Uganda Limited is a commercial bank licensed by the Bank of Uganda, the central bank and national banking regulator. It operates within Uganda's financial services sector.

stp-airways.name: STP Airways
stp-airways.hq: São Tomé, São Tomé and Príncipe
stp-airways.description: STP Airways is the national airline of São Tomé and Príncipe. It is banned from operating into the European Union, so its flights are operated by the Portuguese airline EuroAtlantic Airways. The airline is based in São Tomé and Príncipe.

senegalese-red-cross-society.name: Senegalese Red Cross Society
senegalese-red-cross-society.description: The Senegalese Red Cross Society was established by decree in 1962. It has its headquarters in Dakar. The organization provides emergency and relief services in Senegal.

somafone.name: Somafone
somafone.description: Somafone Telecommunications Service Company is a leading telecommunications firm in Somalia. Established in 2003 as a subsidiary of Somafone FZ LLC of Dubai Internet City, its head offices are located in Mogadishu.

somali-telecom-group.name: Somali Telecom Group
somali-telecom-group.description: Somali Telecom Group (STG) is a telecommunications company founded in 1993 in Rockville, Maryland, USA. It is Somalia's first telecom service provider and maintains offices in 10 Somali cities, with its head offices currently located in Dubai.

somali-postal-service.name: Somali Postal Service
somali-postal-service.description: The Somali Postal Service is the national postal service of Somalia and operates under the Federal Government of Somalia's Ministry of Communications and Technology.

somali-national-television.name: Somali National Television
somali-national-television.description: Somali National Television (SNTV) is the state media television station owned by the Federal Government of Somalia.

sudanese-red-crescent-society.name: Sudanese Red Crescent Society
sudanese-red-crescent-society.description: The Sudanese Red Crescent is the largest humanitarian organization in Sudan, established in 1956. It operates nationwide with 15 state branches and a large volunteer network, maintaining partnerships with public authorities and international agencies.

sudapet.name: Sudapet
sudapet.description: Sudapet is a state-owned oil company based in Sudan. Founded in 1997, it is fully owned by the Ministry for Energy and Mining. The company operates in the petroleum industry within Sudan.

sudatel.name: Sudatel
sudatel.description: Sudatel is a telecommunications and Internet service provider in Sudan. It is responsible for building and maintaining the country's telecom infrastructure and is majority owned by the Sudanese government. Sudatel's stock is listed on the Bahrain Stock Exchange.

sudan-airways.name: Sudan Airways
sudan-airways.description: Sudan Airways is the state-owned flag carrier airline of Sudan, headquartered in Khartoum. It serves as the national airline of the country.

sun-air.name: Sun Air
sun-air.description: Sun Air Aviation is a private airline based in Khartoum, Sudan, currently inoperative. It operated scheduled domestic and international flights but is banned from EU airspace as of 2021.

swaziland-posts-and-telecommunications.name: Swaziland Posts and Telecommunications
swaziland-posts-and-telecommunications.description: Eswatini Posts and Telecommunications Corporation (EPTC) is a parastatal company in Eswatini providing postal and telecommunications services. It is divided into four units: Eswatini Post, Eswatini Telecom, Phutfumani Couriers, and National Contact Centre. The company reports to the Ministry of Information, Communications and Technology.

swaziland-stock-exchange.name: Swaziland Stock Exchange
swaziland-stock-exchange.description: The Eswatini Stock Exchange (ESE) is a small stock exchange headquartered in Mbabane, Eswatini. It was established in 1990 as a non-bank credit institution by Barnabas Sibusiso Dlamini, a former World Bank executive and later Prime Minister of Eswatini.

safarilink-aviation.name: Safarilink Aviation
safarilink-aviation.description: Safarilink Aviation Limited is a regional airline based at Wilson Airport in Nairobi, Kenya. It operates regional air services within the country.

skyward-airlines.name: Skyward Airlines
skyward-airlines.description: Skyward Airlines is a private airline operating in Kenya, providing scheduled passenger and cargo services. Its main operational bases are Wilson Airport and Jomo Kenyatta International Airport, both located in Nairobi, Kenya's capital city.

starbow.name: Starbow
starbow.description: Aero Surveys Limited, trading as Starbow, was a privately owned airline in Ghana operating from 2012 until 2017. It was based in Ghana during its operational years.

star-one.name: Star One
star-one.description: Embratel Star One is a Brazilian communication satellite company and a subsidiary of Embratel. It operates in the telecommunications industry and is based in Brazil, providing satellite communication services.

synergy-group.name: Synergy Group
synergy-group.description: Synergy Group Corp. is a South American conglomerate headquartered in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, owned by Germán Efromovich. It operates airlines such as Avianca Group and is involved in oil and natural gas exploration, hydroelectric power, telecommunications infrastructure, shipbuilding, radiochemistry, agriculture, and hospitality.

samarco.name: Samarco
samarco.description: Samarco Mineração S.A. is a Brazilian mining company founded in 1977. It is a joint venture equally owned by the Brazilian company Vale and the Australian company BHP. Samarco operates in the mining industry.

spoleto.name: Spoleto
spoleto.description: Spoleto is a Brazilian restaurant chain that applies the fast food concept to Italian cuisine. The restaurant is named after the town of Spoleto in Italy.

sodimac.name: Sodimac
sodimac.description: Sodimac Homecenter is a Chilean chain of home improvement stores with locations in several countries including Brazil. It operates in the commerce sector.

seara-foods.name: Seara Foods
seara-foods.description: Seara Foods Ltda. is a Brazilian food processing company specializing in meat products. It was founded in 1956 in the town of Seara, Santa Catarina, Brazil.

sky-brasil.name: Sky Brasil
sky-brasil.description: Sky Brasil is a subscription television service operator in Brazil owned by Vrio. The company produces TV content and owns several TV channels. It operates within the Brazilian telecommunications industry.

sercomtel.name: Sercomtel
sercomtel.description: Sercomtel is a local phone and internet service provider in Paraná, Brazil. It offers landline, mobile, long distance phone services, and broadband internet. It was the only public telephone company in Brazil until its privatization in 2020.

sistema-globo-de-radio.name: Sistema Globo de Rádio
sistema-globo-de-radio.description: Sistema Globo de Rádio is a Brazilian media group owned by Grupo Globo, originating with Rádio Globo in 1944. It controls several radio stations across Brazil and operates in the Pay-TV segment offering music programming to millions of subscribers.

sol-linhas-aereas.name: Sol Linhas Aéreas
sol-linhas-aereas.description: Sol Linhas Aéreas Ltda. was a domestic airline based in Cascavel, Brazil. The summary does not provide further details about its operations or history.

sideral-air-cargo.name: Sideral Air Cargo
sideral-air-cargo.description: Sideral Linhas Aéreas, formerly Sideral Air Cargo, is a Brazilian cargo and passenger charter airline headquartered in São José dos Pinhais, Paraná. It was established in 2009 as a subsidiary of Grupo Econômico Expresso Adorno.

shalom-catholic-community.name: Shalom Catholic Community
shalom-catholic-community.description: The Shalom Catholic Community is an International Private Association of Faithful within the Catholic Church, founded in 1982 in Fortaleza, Brazil. It is affiliated with the Catholic Charismatic Renewal and operates in over 160 dioceses across more than 40 countries. Its headquarters are in Aquiraz, Ceará.

skymaster-airlines.name: Skymaster Airlines
skymaster-airlines.description: Skymaster Airlines was a cargo airline based in Manaus, Brazil. It operated charter cargo services within Brazil and other countries in the Americas. The airline specialized in cargo transportation.

starsat.name: StarSat
starsat.description: StarSat was a South African direct broadcast satellite television service that began broadcasting on 1 May 2010. Operated by On Digital Media, it targeted middle class viewers and was partly owned by Luxembourgish satellite operator SES and Chinese company StarTimes. The service focused on the LSM 6-9 demographic.

santam.name: Santam
santam.description: Santam is a South African financial services group focused on short-term insurance. Founded in 1918, it is headquartered in Bellville, Western Cape. Santam is listed on the JSE Limited and operates within the financial services sector.

spar.name: Spar
spar.description: The Spar Group Ltd, stylized as SPAR, is a major South African supermarket chain and the country's largest by total number of stores. Headquartered in uMhlanga, KwaZulu-Natal, it operates stores under the Dutch SPAR International brand in various countries. The company is traded on the JSE Limited.

steers.name: Steers
steers.description: Steers is a South African quick-service restaurant brand specializing in burgers and chips. Its menu also includes chicken burgers, ribs, ice cream, milkshakes, chicken, and salads.

spur-corporation.name: Spur Corporation
spur-corporation.description: Spur Corporation Limited is a South African restaurant company operating several franchise chains including Casa Bella, Panarotti's, RocoMamas, and Spur Steak Ranches.

south-african-red-cross-society.name: South African Red Cross Society
south-african-red-cross-society.description: The South African Red Cross Society was founded in 1921 and has its headquarters in Johannesburg. It operates in emergency and relief services.

south-african-post-office.name: South African Post Office
south-african-post-office.description: The South African Post Office is the national postal service of South Africa and a state-owned enterprise. It is the oldest institution in South Africa, with origins dating back to 1792.

south-african-breweries.name: South African Breweries
south-african-breweries.description: South African Breweries is a major brewery headquartered in Johannesburg, South Africa. It was formerly a wholly owned subsidiary of SABMiller until its interests were sold to Anheuser-Busch InBev in 2016. It is now a direct subsidiary of Anheuser-Busch InBev SA/NV.

south-african-airways.name: South African Airways
south-african-airways.hq: OR Tambo International Airport, South Africa
south-african-airways.description: South African Airways is the flag carrier airline of South Africa, founded in 1929 as Union Airways and rebranded in 1934. As of February 2026, it flies to 17 destinations with a fleet of 19 aircraft.

safair.name: Safair
safair.description: Safair is an airline based at O.R. Tambo International Airport in Kempton Park, South Africa. It operates one of the world's largest fleets of civil Lockheed L-100 Hercules cargo aircraft. The airline is notable for its specialized cargo fleet.

solenta-aviation.name: Solenta Aviation
solenta-aviation.description: Solenta Aviation is an airline based in Johannesburg, South Africa, with its maintenance base at OR Tambo International Airport. Founded in 2000, it operates cargo flights throughout Sub-Saharan Africa for DHL Aviation and provides passenger charter, cargo, and aircraft lease services, especially for the oil and gas industry.

star-air-cargo.name: Star Air Cargo
star-air-cargo.description: Star Air Cargo Pty Ltd, known as Star Air, is a South African airline that leases out passenger and cargo aircraft. It operates within South Africa's aviation sector, focusing on aircraft leasing services.

south-african-red-cross-air-mercy-servic.name: South African Red Cross Air Mercy Service
south-african-red-cross-air-mercy-servic.legal_name: South African Red Cross Air Mercy Service
south-african-red-cross-air-mercy-servic.hq: Cape Town International Airport, South Africa
south-african-red-cross-air-mercy-servic.description: South African Red Cross Air Mercy Service (AMS) is an air ambulance service headquartered at Cape Town International Airport. It operates various bases across South Africa providing medical air transport services.

ster-kinekor.name: Ster-Kinekor
ster-kinekor.description: Ster-Kinekor is a South African-based cinema company and the country's largest movie exhibitor. Its head office is located at the Ster-Kinekor Office Park in Sandton, Johannesburg.

southern-african-foundation-for-the-cons.name: Southern African Foundation for the Conservation of Coastal Birds
southern-african-foundation-for-the-cons.legal_name: Southern African Foundation for the Conservation of Coastal Birds
southern-african-foundation-for-the-cons.description: The Southern African Foundation for the Conservation of Coastal Birds (SANCCOB) is an international non-profit organisation dedicated to rescuing, rehabilitating, and releasing seabirds in Southern Africa. It operates from its headquarters at the Rietvlei Wetland Reserve in Table View, South Africa.

sonelgaz.name: Sonelgaz
sonelgaz.description: Sonelgaz is a state-owned utility in Algeria responsible for electricity and natural gas distribution. Established in 1969, it replaced Electricité et gaz d'Algérie and held a monopoly on natural gas distribution and electricity production. In 2002, it was converted into a private company and is scheduled to be split eventually.

snvi.name: SNVI
snvi.description: SNVI, formerly the National Society of Mechanical Construction, is an Algerian automaker headquartered in Rouïba. Since 1967, it has produced trucks and buses and also manufactures Mercedes-Benz vehicles.

saidal.name: Saidal
saidal.description: Saidal Group is an Algerian pharmaceutical company established in 1982. It is the largest pharmaceutical company in Algeria and one of the largest in Africa.

star-aviation.name: Star Aviation
star-aviation.description: Star Aviation is an airline based in Hassi Messaoud, Algeria. It operates domestic flights with its main base at Oued Irara–Krim Belkacem Airport. The airline serves the Algerian domestic market.

somatel-liebherr.name: Somatel Liebherr
somatel-liebherr.description: Somatel-Liebherr Spa is a publicly-owned heavy equipment manufacturer located in Constantine, Algeria. It is a joint venture between the German Liebherr Group and Somatel, an Algerian government-owned company. The company began production in 2013.

s-a-c-i-falabella.name: S.A.C.I. Falabella
s-a-c-i-falabella.description: Falabella S.A. is a Chilean multinational retail company operating department stores, shopping centers, supermarkets, banks, and home improvement centers. It is one of the largest retail companies in Latin America with operations in multiple countries.

state-bank-of-chile.name: State Bank of Chile
state-bank-of-chile.description: Banco del Estado de Chile, known as BancoEstado, is the sole public bank in Chile, created by government decree in 1953. It provides financial services nationwide, focusing on the unbanked and small to medium enterprises. It is the largest mortgage lender and debit card issuer in Chile.

santa-isabel.name: Santa Isabel
santa-isabel.description: Supermercados Santa Isabel is a Chilean supermarket chain owned by Cencosud. The stores typically have an average area of 1,500 square meters and operate throughout Chile.

sigdo-koppers.name: Sigdo Koppers
sigdo-koppers.description: Sigdo Koppers S.A. is a Chilean multinational industrial conglomerate founded in 1960 and headquartered in Santiago. It operates through subsidiaries and business units across multiple continents including the Americas, Europe, Asia, Africa, and Oceania.

soprole.name: Soprole
soprole.description: Soprole is a Chilean dairy product maker marketing yogurt, milk, desserts, jelly, and butter. It was part of Fonterra until 2022 and became a subsidiary of Grupo Gloria in 2023.

sociedad-explotadora-de-tierra-del-fuego.name: Sociedad Explotadora de Tierra del Fuego
sociedad-explotadora-de-tierra-del-fuego.legal_name: Sociedad Explotadora de Tierra del Fuego
sociedad-explotadora-de-tierra-del-fuego.description: The Sociedad Explotadora de Tierra del Fuego was a historically important company in Patagonia, Chile and Argentina. Founded in 1893, it cultivated over 1,000,000 hectares for sheep farming and operated factories to process and export sheep meat.

sky-airline.name: Sky Airline
sky-airline.description: Sky Airline is an airline based at Arturo Merino Benítez International Airport in Santiago, Chile. It is the country's second largest airline and the first to operate under a low-cost model. Sky Airline serves international routes in South America and operates charter and domestic flights.

sociedad-comercial-del-plata.name: Sociedad Comercial del Plata
sociedad-comercial-del-plata.description: Sociedad Comercial del Plata is a diversified Argentine holding company with interests in energy, rail transport, real estate, and tourism sectors. The company operates primarily in investment activities.

supermercados-disco.name: Supermercados Disco
supermercados-disco.description: Disco is an Argentine supermarket chain and part of the Chilean retail conglomerate Cencosud since 2004. It operates alongside other Cencosud-owned chains in Argentina, including Jumbo and Vea. The company is involved in the retail sector.

sero-electric.name: Sero Electric
sero-electric.description: Sero Electric is an Argentine manufacturer of electric microcars based in Buenos Aires. The company was founded in 2010 and focuses on producing electric vehicles.

siam.name: Siam
siam.description: SIAM is an Argentine home appliance brand owned by Grupo Industrial Newsan. Founded in 1911 as a mechanical bread machine manufacturer, it expanded into refrigerators, washing machines, vehicles, and industrial equipment, becoming South America's largest metalworking industry by the 1940s.

satellogic.name: Satellogic
satellogic.description: Satellogic Inc. is an Argentine-U.S. company specializing in Earth-observation satellites. Founded in 2010 by Emiliano Kargieman and Gerardo Richarte, it operates in the aerospace industry focusing on satellite technology.

scouts-de-argentina.name: Scouts de Argentina
scouts-de-argentina.description: Scouts de Argentina Asociación Civil is a national Scouting association in Argentina. Founded by Perito Francisco Moreno, it has had several names and was declared the National Institution of Argentine Scouting by presidential decree in 1917. It is a key organization in Argentine scouting.

sancor.name: SanCor
sancor.description: SanCor was a leading dairy producer in Argentina, accounting for one fifth of the country's production and 90% of its dairy exports. It was a large cooperative based in the central milk basin near the Santa Fe and Córdoba provinces.

supermercados-wong.name: Supermercados Wong
supermercados-wong.description: Wong is a supermarket chain in Peru, originally known as E. Wong until 2005. It began as a small store in 1942 founded by Chinese Peruvians in the San Isidro District of Lima.

servicios-industriales-de-la-marina.name: Servicios Industriales de la Marina
servicios-industriales-de-la-marina.description: Servicios Industriales de la Marina S.A. (SIMA) is a Peruvian state-owned shipyard established in 1950, continuing the activities of the former Naval Factory founded in 1845. It pioneered shipbuilding in South America and manufactures large metalworking structures, serving the Peruvian Navy and private clients.

star-peru.name: Star Perú
star-peru.description: Star Perú is a Peruvian airline based at Jorge Chávez International Airport in Lima. Founded in 1997, it operates passenger and cargo flights mainly within Peru and South America. The airline primarily serves domestic routes and also offers international charter flights.

servicios-aereos-de-los-andes.name: Servicios Aéreos de los Andes
servicios-aereos-de-los-andes.description: Servicios Aéreos de los Andes is a Peruvian airline operating fixed-wing aircraft and rotorcraft. Founded in 2005 as a charter airline, it specializes in transporting personnel for mining and oil and gas industries. In 2014, it began commercial flights between Lima, Jauja, and Cusco.

soteltchad.name: SotelTchad
soteltchad.description: Societe des Telecommunications Internationales du Tchad (SotelTchad) is a Chadian telecommunications parastatal providing landline and Internet services. Created in 2000, it was privatized in 2010 and later returned to state control. It partnered with ITXC in 2001 to offer international phone service via Internet telephony.

siragon.name: Síragon
siragon.description: Síragon, C.A. is a Venezuelan manufacturer and assembler of computer hardware and electronic products including digital cameras, tablets, computers, and LCD televisions. The company designs and manufactures its own RAM, flash memory, and printed circuit boards, with a plant located in Valencia, Venezuela.

sidor.name: SIDOR
sidor.description: Siderúrgica de Orinoco "Alfredo Maneiro" SIDOR C.A. is the largest steel corporation in Venezuela. It is located in an industrial zone in Ciudad Guayana, Bolívar State, near the Orinoco River. SIDOR is a key player in the Venezuelan iron and steel industry.

sivensa.name: Sivensa
sivensa.description: Sivensa is the second largest steel producer in Venezuela and the largest in the private sector as of 2008. Founded in 1948, it operates in the Venezuelan iron and steel industry. SIDOR, which was nationalized in 2008, is the largest steel producer overall in the country.

surinam-airways.name: Surinam Airways
surinam-airways.description: Surinam Airways, also known as SLM, is the flag carrier airline of Suriname based in Paramaribo. It operates regional and long-haul scheduled passenger services with its hub at Johan Adolf Pengel International Airport. The airline is wholly owned by the Government of Suriname.

saereo.name: SAEREO
saereo.description: SAEREO was a regional airline based in Quito, Ecuador. It operated charter and domestic passenger services, as well as medivac flights. The airline served the Ecuadorian market before ceasing operations.

sofasa.name: Sofasa
sofasa.description: Sociedad de Fabricación de Automotores (SOFASA) is a Colombian company assembling imported Renault vehicles and formerly Toyota and Daihatsu models. It was the first to produce the Renault Logan in the Americas and exports to the Andean Community while supplying Colombia's national market.

sadelca.name: SADELCA
sadelca.description: SADELCA Ltda. is a cargo airline based at El Dorado International Airport in Bogotá, Colombia. It focuses on air cargo transport services. The company operates from one of Colombia's principal airports.

sarpa.name: SARPA
sarpa.description: SARPA S.A.S. is an air charter and air ambulance operator with its main base at El Dorado International Airport in Bogotá and an auxiliary base in Medellín. It provides specialized air transport services in Colombia. The company operates in the aviation sector.

sandals-resorts.name: Sandals Resorts
sandals-resorts.description: Sandals Resorts is a Jamaican operator of all-inclusive couples resorts in the Caribbean. Part of Sandals Resorts International, it was founded in 1981 and is based in Montego Bay, managing development, service standards, and operations of its resorts.

state-railways-administration-of-uruguay.name: State Railways Administration of Uruguay
state-railways-administration-of-uruguay.description: The State Railways Administration of Uruguay (AFE) is an autonomous agency responsible for rail transport and maintenance of railways in Uruguay. It manages the country's rail infrastructure and services.

skybahamas.name: SkyBahamas
skybahamas.description: Sky Bahamas was an airline based in Nassau, Bahamas. The summary does not provide further details about its operations or status.

southern-air-charter.name: Southern Air Charter
southern-air-charter.hq: Lynden Pindling International Airport, The Bahamas
southern-air-charter.description: Southern Air Charter is an airline and air charter company operating in the Bahamas. It mainly provides air charter services but also offers some scheduled inter-island flights within the Bahamas. The company is based in the Bahamas.

servicios-aereos-profesionales.name: Servicios Aéreos Profesionales
servicios-aereos-profesionales.description: Servicios Aéreos Profesionales, S.A. (SAP) was a charter airline headquartered and based at La Isabela International Airport in Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic.

skyhigh-dominicana.name: SKYhigh Dominicana
skyhigh-dominicana.description: Sky High Aviation Services S.A., operating as SKYhigh Dominicana, is an airline based in the Dominican Republic. It operates scheduled flights within the Caribbean region.

sono-cairo.name: Sono Cairo
sono-cairo.description: Sono Cairo is a multimedia company owned by the Egyptian government. It operates within Egypt's mass media industry.

salah-zulfikar-films-company.name: Salah Zulfikar Films Company
salah-zulfikar-films-company.description: Salah Zulfikar Films Company is a film production company established in 1962 in Cairo, Egypt. It operated in the Middle East and North Africa from 1962 until 1978.

suez-canal-bank.name: Suez Canal Bank
suez-canal-bank.description: Suez Canal Bank is a major Egyptian bank headquartered in Cairo. It provides financial services to individual and corporate clients in Egypt and has a branch in Tripoli, Libya.

sout-el-hob-records.name: Sout El-Hob Records
sout-el-hob-records.description: Sout El-Hob Records is an Egyptian record label founded in 1972 by Atef Montasser. It holds the fourth largest Arabic music catalog in the Middle East and North Africa and has distributed many movies domestically and internationally.

studio-misr.name: Studio Misr
studio-misr.description: Studio Misr is a major Egyptian film studio founded in 1935 by economist and industrialist Talaat Harb. It was the cinema project of Banque Misr, Egypt's first national bank, and is the oldest surviving film studio in Egypt and Africa. It is currently owned by the Egyptian Ministry of Culture.

smart-aviation-company.name: Smart Aviation Company
smart-aviation-company.description: Smart Aviation Company is a corporate airline operator based in Egypt. It launched operations in 2007 from its base at Cairo International Airport.

societe-arabe-internationale-de-banque.name: Societe Arabe Internationale de Banque
societe-arabe-internationale-de-banque.description: Societe Arabe Internationale de Banque, also known as Saib Bank, is a medium-sized Egyptian bank.

sunrise-airways.name: Sunrise Airways
sunrise-airways.description: Sunrise Airways S.A. is a Haitian regional airline established in 2010. It provides scheduled passenger and charter flights to nine domestic and international destinations and operates a fleet of ten aircraft as of January 2024.

sansa.name: SANSA
sansa.description: SANSA is a regional airline based in San José, Costa Rica. It operates scheduled passenger services as part of the former TACA Regional system and was a subsidiary of Avianca Holdings. Its main hub is Juan Santamaría International Airport.

sotelma.name: Sotelma
sotelma.description: Sotelma is a private telecommunications company based in Bamako, Mali. It provides local and international telephony, internet service, and mobile telephone service through its subsidiary Malitel. Sotelma is also the official registry of the .ml country code domain.

savings-and-credit-bank.name: Savings and Credit Bank
savings-and-credit-bank.description: Banco de Poupança e Crédito is a government-owned full-service bank in Angola with the largest branch network in the country, including a branch in Cabinda.

sodiam.name: SODIAM
sodiam.description: Sociedade de Comercialização de Diamantes is Angola's national diamond trading company, partly owned by ENDIAMA. It markets diamonds from partnered mines and artisanal miners to national and international markets.

sociedade-de-desenvolvimento-mineiro.name: Sociedade de Desenvolvimento Mineiro
sociedade-de-desenvolvimento-mineiro.description: Sociedade de Desenvolvimento Mineiro (SDM) is an Angolan public mining company holding mining rights in a 2,950 km2 concession in Lunda Norte Province. It is a joint venture between the Angolan public company Endiama and the Brazilian private company OMSI.

sonair.name: SonAir
sonair.description: SonAir Airline Services, S.A., commonly known as SonAir, is an Angolan airline established on 10 October 1979. It is a venture of the Angolan national petroleum company Sonangol Group.

safari-plus.name: Safari Plus
safari-plus.description: Safari Plus Limited is an air charter company based in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania. It is included on the list of airlines banned in the European Union.

societe-tunisienne-de-banque.name: Société Tunisienne de Banque
societe-tunisienne-de-banque.description: Société Tunisienne de Banque is a state-controlled bank in Tunisia, listed on the Bourse de Tunis. Its capital participation includes public and semi-public sectors, private sector, and foreign actors.

standard-chartered-zambia.name: Standard Chartered Zambia
standard-chartered-zambia.description: Standard Chartered Zambia, officially Standard Chartered Bank Zambia Plc, is a commercial bank in Zambia and a subsidiary of Standard Chartered. It is licensed by the Bank of Zambia, the country's central bank and regulator.

south-sudan-broadcasting-corporation.name: South Sudan Broadcasting Corporation
south-sudan-broadcasting-corporation.description: The South Sudan Broadcasting Corporation (SSBC) is the national public service broadcaster of South Sudan. It provides radio and television services via analogue transmitters in Juba and broadcasts globally through multiple satellites.

south-sudan-red-cross.name: South Sudan Red Cross
south-sudan-red-cross.description: The South Sudan Red Cross Society was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Juba, South Sudan. It operates as a humanitarian organization providing emergency and relief services.

sears-mexico.name: Sears Mexico
sears-mexico.description: Sears Operadora México, S.A. de C.V. is a department store chain operating 93 stores across Mexico. It is operated by Grupo Sanborns, a division of Grupo Carso. The company is based in Mexico.

suburbia.name: Suburbia
suburbia.description: Suburbia is a Mexican chain of department stores founded in 1970 in Mexico City and now part of El Puerto de Liverpool group. It sells clothing, appliances, electronics, and cell phones targeting middle and lower economic classes. As of December 2023, it had 180 stores across Mexico.

senor-frog-s.name: Señor Frog's
senor-frog-s.description: Señor Frog's is a Mexican-themed franchised bar and grill located in tourist destinations throughout Mexico, the Caribbean, Tenerife, and the United States. It operates as a fast food restaurant chain.

softtek.name: Softtek
softtek.description: Softtek is a Mexico-based information technology company headquartered in Monterrey. It operates in North America, Latin America, Europe, and Asia, offering software development, testing, security, BPO, and IT infrastructure management. It is the largest private IT vendor in Latin America.

squad.name: Squad
squad.description: Squad is a Mexican video game developer known for creating Kerbal Space Program, a space flight simulation game released in 2015. The game features realistic orbital physics and is available on multiple platforms including Linux, macOS, Windows, and consoles. Squad is based in Mexico.

sky-mexico.name: Sky México
sky-mexico.description: Sky México, a trading name of Corporacion Novavision, operates subscription television services in Mexico, Central America, and the Dominican Republic. Owned by Grupo Televisa, it produces TV content, owns several channels, and held a 59% market share in subscription TV as of 2022.

senor-air.name: Señor Air
senor-air.description: Cabo Flight Center, formerly known as Señor Air, is a Mexican regional carrier based at Cabo San Lucas International Airport. It launched scheduled operations on December 8, 2023, starting with one Embraer ERJ-135 aircraft. An Embraer ERJ-145 is expected to be added in 2024.

supercell.name: Supercell
supercell.hq: Goma, Democratic Republic of the Congo
supercell.description: Supercell is a mobile phone network owned by Supercell SPRL operating in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo.

segesa.name: Segesa
segesa.description: SEGESA is the national electricity company of Equatorial Guinea, headquartered in Malabo. It is the sole operator of the country's electricity sector and was formed in 2001 by merging two national companies. In 2013, it reorganized into three units for distribution, generation, and transmission, overseen by SEGESA Holding.
